docs.title: 11.9.1. lib/etat/session.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/etat/session.dart - Is QUI logged in?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The logged-in user (or null), in a ChangeNotifier provided to any
// application (provider, see Example 20): readable by the ET screens via
// the router, which listens for it to reevaluate its guards (refreshListenable).
//
// The JWT token itself is not present here: it is stored in a cookie (managed by the
// web browser, or by ClientAvecCookies on the phone). The
// session only stores the user’s DESCRIPTION ({ login, name, role }).
//
// When the application starts, the session is empty: `verifier()` sends
// the server—only once—to check which user is logged in (GET /api/auth/moi).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';

class Session extends ChangeNotifier {
  final RdvMedecinsApi _api;
  Utilisateur? _utilisateur;
   // true after a logout (VOULUE; button, account deletion); false
   // after a session has expired. The router takes this into account (see routeur.dart)
  bool _departVolontaire = false;
   // Has the question “Who is logged in?” already been asked of the server?
  Future<void>? _verification;

  Session(this._api);

  Utilisateur? get utilisateur => _utilisateur;
  bool get departVolontaire => _departVolontaire;

   // only queries the server the first time (the Future is retained)
  Future<void> verifier() => _verification ??= _api.moi().then(
    (u) => _changer(u),
    onError: (Object _) => _changer(null), // 401: No one; or server unreachable
  );

  Future<void> connecter(String login, String password, String captchaId, String captcha) async {
    _changer(await _api.connecter(login, password, captchaId, captcha));
  }

   // The user has changed their name or login (PUT /api/my-account)
  void mettreAJour(Utilisateur u) => _changer(u);

  Future<void> deconnecter() async {
    try {
      await _api.deconnecter();
    } finally {
      oublier(volontaire: true);
    }
  }

   // without making a request to the server: session expired, account deleted
  void oublier({bool volontaire = false}) => _changer(null, volontaire: volontaire);

   // notifyListeners: the router (refreshListenable) reevaluates its guards, and
   // automatically exits a screen that the new user is not authorized to view
  void _changer(Utilisateur? u, {bool volontaire = false}) {
    _utilisateur = u;
    _departVolontaire = volontaire;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

// which we infer from the user: extensions (getter methods added to User?)
extension Droits on Utilisateur? {
  bool get estAdmin => this?.role == Role.admin;
  bool get estPatient => this?.role == Role.user;
   // ADMIN and DOCTOR: schedule and cancel appointments for any patient
  bool get estGestionnaire => this?.role == Role.admin || this?.role == Role.doctor;
   // the home page for each role, immediately after logging in
  String get pageAccueil => estPatient ? '/mon-espace' : '/agenda';
}

Who is logged in? The session stores the user's DESCRIPTION (login, name, role), not the token, which remains in the user's cookie.

  • Lines 36–38: The question “Who is logged in?” is sent to the server ([GET /api/auth/moi]) UNE only once, at startup: [??=] only affects [Future] if [_verification] is [null]. Subsequent calls return the same [Future], which has already been completed: the router can call [verifier()] before each navigation at no cost. At startup, if the stored cookie contains a token that is still valid, the user remains logged in;
  • lines 41–42: the connection: if the server refuses, [_api.connecter] initiates a [ErreurApi], and [_changer] is not called;
  • lines 48–52: logout: the user is forgotten even if the server does not respond ([finally]);
  • lines 61–64: all changes go through here, and notify the listeners: the screens displaying the user (the template), the cache (which is cleared), and the router (which reevaluates its guards). [_departVolontaire] distinguishes between an intentional logout and an expired session (see [routeur.dart]);
  • lines 69–75: an extension adds getters to an existing type, in this case [Utilisateur?]: [session.utilisateur.estAdmin] is [false] if no one is logged in, without first checking for [null] ([this?.role]).

docs.title: 11.9.2. lib/etat/messages.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/etat/messages.dart - messages displayed to the user
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same layout as other clients of RdvMedecins:
//    - a SUCCÈS is displayed as HAUT on the screen (green banner);
//    - a ERREUR appears as BAS (pink banner), which remains visible.
// A message is a translation CLÉ (+ its settings): it is therefore re-translated
// on its own if the user changes the language.
//
// "Flash" messages: an action that ends with a change
// (reservation, adding a doctor, etc.) places its message with
// flash(); it will appear on the SUIVANT screen, then disappear upon
// next page transition. The router calls nouvellePage() at the
// end of each navigation (see routeur.dart).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';

typedef Message = ({String cle, Map<String, String> params});

class Messages extends ChangeNotifier {
  Message? succes;
  Message? erreur;
   // the messages to display on the next screen
  Message? _succesEnAttente;
  Message? _erreurEnAttente;

  void afficherSucces(String cle, [Map<String, String> params = const {}]) {
    succes = (cle: cle, params: params);
    erreur = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void afficherErreur(String cle, [Map<String, String> params = const {}]) {
    erreur = (cle: cle, params: params);
    succes = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

   // a ErreurApi -> the screen message; any other error is a
   // client error, which is allowed to be reported
  void afficherErreurApi(Object e) {
    if (e is! ErreurApi) throw e;
    afficherErreur(e.cle, e.params);
  }

  void effacer() {
    succes = null;
    erreur = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }

   // for screen SUIVANT
  void flash({bool succes = true, required String cle, Map<String, String> params = const {}}) {
    if (succes) {
      _succesEnAttente = (cle: cle, params: params);
    } else {
      _erreurEnAttente = (cle: cle, params: params);
    }
  }

   // a new screen: the messages from the previous screen disappear, and the
   // flash messages appear
  void nouvellePage() {
    succes = _succesEnAttente;
    erreur = _erreurEnAttente;
    _succesEnAttente = null;
    _erreurEnAttente = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

Application messages: a success message at the top of the screen, an error message at the bottom (see [gabarit.dart]).

  • Line 21: A message is a CLÉ translation record and its parameters (a single record). It is translated only when displayed: changing the language re-translates the displayed messages;
  • Lines 44–46: A [ErreurApi] becomes the screen’s error message. Any other exception is a client-side issue: we re-throw it so that it appears in the console during development, rather than hiding it;
  • lines 56–60: a message for screen SUIVANT: an action that ends with a screen change (a reservation, an addition, etc.) places its message here;
  • lines 66–71: called every time the address changes (see [main.dart]): messages from the previous screen disappear, and flash messages appear.

docs.title: 11.9.3. lib/etat/cache.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/etat/cache.dart—the data already read from the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The list of doctors hardly ever changes: no need to reload it
// every time you visit the calendar. The cache stores the Future of each read,
// under a CLÉ ('doctors', 'calendar/1/2026-10-05'...):
//
//      cache.lire('doctors', () => api.lister(TypePersonnes.medecins))
//
// returns the Future that has already been cached, or initiates the read operation and caches it.
// After a modification, the affected keys are INVALIDE (they will be
// read again on the next request): cache.invalider('agenda').
// A failed read is not retained: the next request will retry.
// The cache is a ChangeNotifier: invalidate() notifies its listeners. A
// screen is still active (even if hidden under another one in the stack, such as
// the calendar beneath its booking window) can thus read its data again.
// In a nutshell, this is what the TanStack Query library of the
// React client.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

class Cache extends ChangeNotifier {
  final Map<String, Future<Object?>> _futurs = {};

  Future<T> lire<T>(String cle, Future<T> Function() charger) {
    final futur = _futurs.putIfAbsent(cle, () {
      final f = charger();
       // If the request fails, this Future is discarded (the next request will retry)
      f.then((_) {}, onError: (Object _) => _futurs.remove(cle));
      return f;
    });
    return futur.then((v) => v as T);
  }

   // Discards all keys that start with the prefix and notifies the screens
  void invalider(String prefixe) {
    _futurs.removeWhere((cle, _) => cle.startsWith(prefixe));
    notifyListeners();
  }

   // user switch: everything is discarded; SANS notifies (the screens from
   // the previous user will disappear; they must not re-read anything)
  void vider() => _futurs.clear();
}

Data already read from the server: the equivalent, in a few lines, of [TanStack Query] in the [React] client.

  • Line 24: The cache stores [Future], not actual values: two screens requesting the same data while it is in transit receive MÊME and [Future], and only a single request is sent;
  • Lines 26–33: A generic method: [lire<List<Personne>>(...)] returns a [Future<List<Personne>>] (the type [T] is most often inferred from the function [charger]). [putIfAbsent]: the value of the key, or, if the key is missing, the result of the function, stored under that key. A failed read is ignored: the next request will try again;
  • lines 37–39: After a modification, the affected keys are discarded, and the screens are notified. The calendar screen listens for this: after a reservation, it reloads itself, even if hidden behind the reservation window;
  • line 44: when the user changes, everything is cleared without notifying anyone: the previous user’s screens will disappear; they have nothing to reload.

docs.title: 11.10.1. lib/formatage.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/formatage.dart - display of hours and days
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server sends data BRUTES (start_hour: 8, start_minute: 0; day:
// "2026-10-05"); the formatting, which depends on the language, is the responsibility
// the client (see example 09).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import 'api/types.dart';

String _deux(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

// "8:05" rather than "8:5"
String heure(int h, int m) => '$h:${_deux(m)}';

// "8:00 - 8:20"
String horaire(Creneau c) => '${heure(c.hdebut, c.mdebut)} - ${heure(c.hfin, c.mfin)}';

// a date -> "yyyy-MM-dd" (the format of API)
String versJour(DateTime d) => '${d.year}-${_deux(d.month)}-${_deux(d.day)}';

String aujourdhui() => versJour(DateTime.now());

// true if "day" is a valid date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
bool estUneDateValide(String jour) {
  if (!RegExp(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$').hasMatch(jour)) return false;
  final d = DateTime.tryParse(jour);
  return d != null && versJour(d) == jour; // 2026-02-30 -> 2026-03-02: rejected
}

// "Monday, October 5, 2026"
String jourLong(String jour, String langue) => DateFormat.yMMMMEEEEd(langue).format(DateTime.parse(jour));

Formatting the raw data from the server (see example 09):

  • line 22: a [DateTime] in the format of API (“2026-10-05”);
  • lines 27–30: Is the date in the address valid? [DateTime.tryParse] accepts “2026-02-30” (March 2): we verify that the same string is present;
  • line 34: “Monday, October 5, 2026” or “lundi 5 octobre 2026,” depending on the language ([DateFormat.yMMMMEEEEd] derived from [intl]).

docs.title: 11.11.1. lib/routeur.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/routeur.dart - application screens and their access permissions
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The MÊMES URLs that other clients use (/login, /calendar, /doctors,
// /my-space...). On the web, they appear in the address bar;
// on a phone, they remain invisible but still organize
// the app (and the stack of screens for the Back button).
//
// All screens are in a ShellRoute, including the widget, Template, and the
// appears between the top bar and the error area.
//
// The GARDES: the redirect function of the GoRouter is called before CHAQUE
// navigation. It can be asynchronous: the first time (when
// the application, F5 on the web), it waits for the server’s response to the
// question “Who is logged in?” (session.verifier()). Then it checks the
// permissions for the requested screen (droitsDe), and redirects if necessary.
// RAPPEL: These checks are merely a CONFORT (do not display an
// is unnecessary). Data protection is ensured by the server, which
// verifies the token and role for each CHAQUE request.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import 'api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import 'api/types.dart';
import 'etat/messages.dart';
import 'etat/session.dart';
import 'pages/agenda.dart';
import 'pages/connexion.dart';
import 'pages/espace_patient.dart';
import 'pages/inscription.dart';
import 'pages/mon_compte.dart';
import 'pages/page_erreur.dart';
import 'pages/personne_formulaire.dart';
import 'pages/personnes.dart';
import 'widgets/gabarit.dart';

// the access rights for a screen: public (without login), or restricted to
// certain roles (null: all logged-in roles)
typedef Droits = ({bool public, Set<Role>? roles});

Droits droitsDe(String chemin) => switch (chemin) {
   '/login' || '/registration' => (public: true, roles: null),
  _ when chemin.startsWith('/medecins') || chemin.startsWith('/clients') => (public: false, roles: {Role.admin}),
   '/my-space' || '/my-account' => (public: false, roles: {Role.user}),
   '/calendar' || '/restricted' || '/' => (public: false, roles: null),
  _ => (public: true, roles: null), // unknown address: 404 page for all
};

// only one path: INTERNE ("/doctors"): never "//autre-site.com"
String? cheminInterne(String? r) => r != null && r.startsWith('/') && !r.startsWith('//') ? r: null;

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", missing (null) -> null
int? entierPositif(String? valeur) {
  final n = int.tryParse(valeur ?? '');
  return n != null && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

GoRouter creerRouteur(Session session, Messages messages, RdvMedecinsApi api) {
   // the three screens for managing doctors OU for clients (ADMIN)
  List<GoRoute> routesPersonnes(TypePersonnes type) => [
    GoRoute(
      path: '/${type.name}',
      builder: (_, _) => PagePersonnes(type: type),
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: '/${type.name}/ajouter',
      builder: (_, _) => PagePersonneFormulaire(type: type),
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: '/${type.name}/:id/modifier',
      builder: (_, etat) {
        final id = entierPositif(etat.pathParameters['id']);
         // /doctors/abc/edit: this address does not exist
        return id == null ? const PageErreur(code: 404) : PagePersonneFormulaire(type: type, id: id);
      },
    ),
  ];

  return GoRouter(
    initialLocation: '/login',
     // Session changes (login, logout, expiration): the on-call schedules
     // are recalculated for the current screen
    refreshListenable: session,
    redirect: (context, etat) async {
      await session.verifier();
      final utilisateur = session.utilisateur;
      final chemin = etat.uri.path;
      final droits = droitsDe(chemin);
      if (droits.public) {
         // logged in: the login screen is no longer relevant. It is ICI that
         // exits, immediately after logging in: the session has changed, and the router
         // (which is listening for it) reevaluates its watchers. We go to the requested screen before
         // the connection (?redirect=...), otherwise to the role’s home page
        if (chemin == '/login' && utilisateur != null) {
          return cheminInterne(etat.uri.queryParameters['redirect']) ?? utilisateur.pageAccueil;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (utilisateur == null) {
         // intentional logout: simply the login screen
        if (session.departVolontaire) return '/login';
         // session expired, page opened without being logged in: we save
         // the requested screen, to return to it after logging in
        return Uri(path: '/login', queryParameters: {'redirect': etat.uri.toString()}).toString();
      }
      if (chemin == '/') return utilisateur.pageAccueil;
      if (droits.roles != null && !droits.roles!.contains(utilisateur.role)) return '/interdit';
      return null;
    },
    routes: [
      ShellRoute(
        builder: (context, etat, child) => Gabarit(child: child),
        routes: [
          GoRoute(path: '/', builder: (_, _) => const PageErreur(code: 404)), // (redirected above)
          GoRoute(
            path: '/login',
            builder: (_, etat) {
               // the login for the URL: 30 characters maximum
              final login = etat.uri.queryParameters['login'] ?? '';
              return PageConnexion(login: login.length > 30 ? login.substring(0, 30) : login);
            },
          ),
          GoRoute(
            path: '/agenda',
            builder: (_, etat) => PageAgenda(
              idMedecin: entierPositif(etat.uri.queryParameters['idMedecin']),
              jour: etat.uri.queryParameters['jour'],
              reserver: entierPositif(etat.uri.queryParameters['reserver']),
            ),
          ),
          ...routesPersonnes(TypePersonnes.medecins),
          ...routesPersonnes(TypePersonnes.clients),
          GoRoute(
            path: '/inscription',
             // a guard PROPRE on this route: no passcode (captcha
             // resolved on the login screen), return to the login screen
            redirect: (context, etat) async {
              final valide = await api.etatAccesInscription().catchError((_) => false);
              if (valide) return null;
              messages.flash(succes: false, cle: 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
              return '/login';
            },
            builder: (_, _) => const PageInscription(),
          ),
          GoRoute(path: '/mon-espace', builder: (_, _) => const PageEspacePatient()),
          GoRoute(path: '/mon-compte', builder: (_, _) => const PageMonCompte()),
          GoRoute(path: '/interdit', builder: (_, _) => const PageErreur(code: 403)),
        ],
      ),
    ],
     // an address not recognized by any route: 404 page, in the template
    errorBuilder: (context, etat) => const Gabarit(child: PageErreur(code: 404)),
  );
}

The application screens, their addresses, and their access rights (see examples 17 and 18).

  • Line 40: a screen’s access rights: public, or restricted to certain roles ([null]: all roles);
  • Lines 42–47: the permissions for each address; in UN, only one location: a [switch] string expression. ['/login' || '/inscription']: an “or” pattern; [_ when ...]: an “anything” pattern, with a condition (a guard);
  • line 51: the address [?redirect=] is only followed if it is a path INTERNE: on the web, an address [/login?redirect=//site-pirate.com] sent by email must not take the user elsewhere after they log in;
  • lines 54–56: The parameters of an address are strings, written by anyone (on the web): “abc” or “-2” become [null];
  • lines 61–78: a local function that generates the three routes for the doctors’ OU from the clients: [/medecins], [/medecins/ajouter], [/medecins/:id/modifier]. [:id]: a path parameter, read by [etat.pathParameters['id']];
  • line 81: the initial screen on the phone (on the web, this is the address entered);
  • line 84: the router monitors the session: with each change (connection, disconnection, expiration), it reevaluates its guards for the current screen and switches screens if necessary;
  • lines 85–109: LE guard, called before each navigation:
    • line 86: the first time, we wait for the server’s response to the question “who is logged in?”; after that, this call costs nothing;
    • lines 90–98: A public screen is accessible to everyone; however, a logged-in user has no business being on the login screen: they go to the screen they requested before logging in, or to the home screen for their role. This is how the application exits the login screen after a successful login: the login screen itself does not need to navigate;
    • lines 100–105: No one is logged in: proceed to the login screen. After a session has expired, or if a protected URL (on the web) was opened directly, the requested screen ([?redirect=]) is retained so that the user can return to it after logging in; after an intentional logout, it is not retained;
    • lines 107–108: [/] leads to the role’s home page; an insufficient role leads to a 403 page;
  • lines 112–113: All screens are displayed within the template (the top bar, the menu, the messages);
  • lines 117–121: [/login?login=jbernard] (after creating an account) pre-fills the login field;
  • lines 125–129: the three calendar parameters, read from the URL; the entire screen state is present there (see [agenda.dart]);
  • lines 135–142: a PROPRE token for a route: account creation requires a pass, which the server issues once the CAPTCHA has been entered ([POST /api/inscription/acces], see login screen). Without it, you are redirected to the login screen with a message;
  • line 153: an address not mapped to any route: the 404 page, as defined in the template.

These safeguards are merely a formality: they prevent a useless screen from being displayed. Data protection is ensured by the server, which re-verifies the token and role with every request.

docs.title: 11.12.1. lib/widgets/gabarit.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/widgets/gabarit.dart - the GABARIT common to all screens
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The router’s ShellRoute widget (see routeur.dart):
//    - the top bar: title, language (FR / EN), logout;
//    - the side menu (“drawer”), opened by the ☰ button: the
//      screens permitted for the user’s role. “Doctors” and “Clients”
//      appear only for the ADMIN: this is simply for display convenience; the
//      actual protection is provided by the server;
//    - a success message in HAUT;
//    - the current screen (child);
//    - the error area in BAS.
// On a large screen (web, tablet), the menu is displayed permanently
// on the left: a NavigationRail instead of the drawer.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../etat/session.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';

// A menu entry: path, label key, icon
typedef EntreeMenu = ({String chemin, String cle, IconData icone});

List<EntreeMenu> entreesMenu(Session session) {
  final u = session.utilisateur;
  if (u == null) return const [];
  return [
    if (u.estPatient) (chemin: '/mon-espace', cle: 'APP.MENU_MY_SPACE', icone: Icons.home),
    (chemin: '/agenda', cle: 'APP.MENU_AGENDA', icone: Icons.calendar_month),
    if (u.estAdmin) ...[
      (chemin: '/medecins', cle: 'APP.MENU_DOCTORS', icone: Icons.medical_services),
      (chemin: '/clients', cle: 'APP.MENU_PATIENTS', icone: Icons.people),
    ],
    if (u.estPatient) (chemin: '/mon-compte', cle: 'APP.MENU_ACCOUNT', icone: Icons.manage_accounts),
  ];
}

class Gabarit extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;

  const Gabarit({super.key, required this.child});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final traductions = context.watch<Traductions>();
    final t = traductions.t;
    final session = context.watch<Session>();
    final u = session.utilisateur;
    final entrees = entreesMenu(session);
     // the current address, as known to the router
    final chemin = GoRouter.of(context).routerDelegate.currentConfiguration.uri.path;
    final actif = entrees.indexWhere((e) => chemin.startsWith(e.chemin));
     // MediaQuery: screen dimensions; if greater than 800 points, a large screen
    final grandEcran = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 800;

     // the session times out; the router, which is listening for it, displays the login screen
    Future<void> seDeconnecter() => session.deconnecter().catchError((_) {}); // even if the server does not respond

    final contenu = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        const _MessageSucces(),
        Expanded(child: child),
        const _ZoneErreur(),
      ],
    );

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(t('APP.TITLE')),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimary,
        actions: [
           // FR / EN: no request is sent to the server; the screen is rendered locally
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            tooltip: t('APP.LANGUAGE'),
             // text, in the color of the toolbar icons (onPrimary)
            icon: Text(
              traductions.langue.toUpperCase(),
              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimary),
            ),
            onSelected: traductions.changerLangue,
            itemBuilder: (_) => [for (final l in langues) PopupMenuItem(value: l, child: Text(l.toUpperCase()))],
          ),
          if (u != null) IconButton(tooltip: t('APP.LOGOUT'), icon: const Icon(Icons.logout), onPressed: seDeconnecter),
        ],
      ),
       // the drawer: only when logged in, and only on a small screen
      drawer: u == null || grandEcran
          ? null
          : NavigationDrawer(
              selectedIndex: actif < 0 ? null : actif,
              onDestinationSelected: (i) {
                Navigator.pop(context); // closes the drawer
                context.go(entrees[i].chemin);
              },
              children: [
                 // Header: Who is logged in
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(28, 16, 16, 10),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(u.nom, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
                      Chip(label: Text(u.role.name.toUpperCase())),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                for (final e in entrees) NavigationDrawerDestination(icon: Icon(e.icone), label: Text(t(e.cle))),
              ],
            ),
      body: u == null || !grandEcran
          ? contenu
          : Row(
              children: [
                NavigationRail(
                  selectedIndex: actif < 0 ? null : actif,
                  labelType: NavigationRailLabelType.all,
                  onDestinationSelected: (i) => context.go(entrees[i].chemin),
                  destinations: [
                    for (final e in entrees) NavigationRailDestination(icon: Icon(e.icone), label: Text(t(e.cle))),
                  ],
                ),
                const VerticalDivider(width: 1),
                Expanded(child: contenu),
              ],
            ),
    );
  }
}

// the success message, at the top
class _MessageSucces extends StatelessWidget {
  const _MessageSucces();

  @override

    final succes = context.watch<Messages>().succes;

// the error area, at the bottom: always visible, even when scrolling
class _ZoneErreur extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ZoneErreur();

  @override

    final erreur = context.watch<Messages>().erreur;
    if (erreur == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

        top: false,

          leading: Icon(Icons.error, color: Colors.red.shade800),
          title: Text(t(erreur.cle, erreur.params), style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red.shade900)),
          trailing: IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.close), onPressed: context.read<Messages>().effacer),
        ),

The [ShellRoute] widget: the element that surrounds all screens.

  • Line 26: a menu entry: a record;
  • lines 28–38: entries permitted for the user’s role, via a [if] in a list (example 03). [...[...]]: the decomposition operator inserts multiple elements at once;
  • line 55: the current address, to mark the active menu entry;
  • line 58: the screen width, in points. Above 800 points (the web, a tablet in landscape mode), the menu will be displayed permanently;
  • line 61: logout—the session is cleared, and the router, which is listening for this, displays the login screen. [catchError]: even if the server does not respond, the user is considered logged out;
  • lines 63–68: the success message at the top, the screen in the middle ([Expanded]: all remaining space), the error at the bottom;
  • lines 73–89: the top bar: the title, the language menu ([PopupMenuButton]: a button that opens a list; its icon here is text, “FR” or “EN”), the logout button;
  • lines 93–113: on a small screen, a drawer ([NavigationDrawer]), which opens via the ☰ button that [Scaffold] automatically adds to the top bar. Tapping an entry closes the drawer ([Navigator.pop]) and changes the URL;
  • Lines 116–129: On a large screen, a [NavigationRail]: the menu, arranged in a column to the left of the content;
  • lines 137–154: the success message. [context.watch<Messages>()]: the widget is rebuilt every time the messages change; when there are no messages, it takes up no space ([SizedBox.shrink]);
  • lines 168–169: the error area is at the bottom of the screen: [SafeArea] keeps it separate from the phone’s navigation bar (the buttons or gesture bar of [Android]).

docs.title: 11.12.3. lib/widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart - send a form to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All forms in the app follow the same pattern as
// Example 25: no rules are checked on the phone (they reside
// in a single location—the server—and in case of rejection:
//    - the error for each field (ErreurApi.champs) is displayed below the field;
//    - the general message (ErreurApi.cle) appears at the bottom of the screen.
// This class groups these actions (it is the Command from Example 23,
// supplemented with field errors). A screen creates one per form:
//
//      final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(messages);
//      if (await _envoi.envoyer(() => api.inscrire(input))) { ... }
//      ChampSaisie(..., error: _submit.errors['nom'])
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';

class EnvoiFormulaire extends ChangeNotifier {
  final Messages _messages;
   // the error for each field: a CLÉ translation
  Map<String, String> erreurs = {};
   // error message parameters ({{min}}...), returned by the server
  Map<String, String> params = {};
  bool enCours = false;

  EnvoiFormulaire(this._messages);

   // executes the send; returns true if successful. In case of ErreurApi, the
   // errors are displayed and false is returned
  Future<bool> envoyer(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    if (enCours) return false; // no duplicate submission
    erreurs = {};
    params = {};
    enCours = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      await action();
      return true;
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      _messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
      erreurs = e.champs;
      params = e.params;
      return false;
    } finally {
      enCours = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

   // the user modifies a field: the error disappears
  void effacerErreur(String champ) {
    if (erreurs.containsKey(champ)) {
      erreurs = {...erreurs}..remove(champ);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}

Submitting a form to the server: the [Commande] from Example 23, supplemented with field errors (Example 25).

  • Lines 34–50: Submission: no duplicate submissions; during submission, [enCours] (the buttons are disabled); if [ErreurApi] occurs, the general message at the bottom of the screen and the error for each field are displayed. [finally] runs in all cases, even after a [return];
  • lines 55–57: the user corrects a field; the error disappears. We replace the [Map] with a copy, rather than modifying it: the old one may have been provided by the server ([e.champs]), and a constant [Map] ([const {}]) does not change.

docs.title: 11.12.4. lib/widgets/champ_saisie.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/widgets/champ_saisie.dart - a completed form field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Label + field + tooltip OU error message. All
// forms in the application use it:
//
//    ChampSaisie (label: 'PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL', longueurMax: 20,
//                value: _entry['nom'], onChanged: (v) => _modifier('name', v),
//                error: _send.errors['nom'])
//
// This is a CONTRÔLÉ widget (see Example 11): the value belongs to the
// parent form; didUpdateWidget copies a value into the field that
// the parent itself has changed. Label, help, and error are CLÉS from
// translation; "params" refers to the parameters of their messages ({{min}}...).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../i18n/traductions.dart';

class ChampSaisie extends StatefulWidget {
  final String libelle;
  final String valeur;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
  final String? erreur;
  final String? aide;
  final Map<String, String> params;
  final bool secret; // a password: hidden characters
  final int? longueurMax;
  final bool autofocus;
  final Iterable<String>? autofill; // for the phone’s password manager

  const ChampSaisie({
    super.key,
    required this.libelle,
    required this.valeur,
    required this.onChanged,
    this.erreur,
    this.aide,
    this.params = const {},
    this.secret = false,
    this.longueurMax,
    this.autofocus = false,
    this.autofill,
  });

  @override
  State<ChampSaisie> createState() => _ChampSaisieState();
}

class _ChampSaisieState extends State<ChampSaisie> {
  late final _controleur = TextEditingController(text: widget.valeur);

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(ChampSaisie ancien) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(ancien);
    if (widget.valeur != _controleur.text) _controleur.text = widget.valeur;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controleur.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final erreur = widget.erreur;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: TextField(
        controller: _controleur,
        obscureText: widget.secret,
        autocorrect: !widget.secret,
        autofocus: widget.autofocus,
        maxLength: widget.longueurMax,
        autofillHints: widget.autofill,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: t(widget.libelle),
          errorText: erreur == null ? null : t(erreur, widget.params),
          helperText: widget.aide == null ? null : t(widget.aide!, widget.params),
          helperMaxLines: 2,
          errorMaxLines: 3,
          counterText: '', // no "0/20" counter below the field
        ),
        onChanged: widget.onChanged,
      ),
    );
  }
}

A complete form field: label, field, help text, or error message. All forms use this.

  • lines 22–32: the parameters. The label, help text, and error message are translation-specific CLÉS fields;
  • lines 53–58: a controlled widget (Example 11): the value belongs to the parent. If the parent changes it itself (the CAPTCHA cleared after a failure), [didUpdateWidget] copies it back into the field;
  • lines 75–79: a password is masked, and the spell checker does not interfere; [autofillHints] tells the phone’s password manager what the field contains (a username, a password, a new password);
  • lines 80–86: the label, the error message (which replaces the help text), and the help text. [maxLength] limits the input and would display a counter (“3/20”) below the field; [counterText: ''] hides it.

// ADMIN, "Create a Customer Account," and "Manage My Account." The parent

//      ChampsPersonne (values: _saisie, errors: _envoi.erreurs, errors: onChanged: _modifier)

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import 'champ_saisie.dart';

const titres = ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle'];

class ChampsPersonne extends StatelessWidget {
  final Map<String, Object?> valeurs;
  final Map<String, String> erreurs;
  final void Function(String champ, String valeur) onChanged;

  const ChampsPersonne({super.key, required this.valeurs, required this.erreurs, required this.onChanged});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final erreurTitre = erreurs['titre'];
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
         // DropdownButtonFormField: a drop-down list with label and error
        DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
           // key: if the value changes via code, the field is recreated with that value
          key: ValueKey(valeurs['titre']),
          initialValue: valeurs['titre'] as String,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            labelText: t('PERSONNES.TITLE_LABEL'),
            errorText: erreurTitre == null ? null : t(erreurTitre),
          ),
          items: [for (final titre in titres) DropdownMenuItem(value: titre, child: Text(titre))],
          onChanged: (titre) => onChanged('titre', titre!),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        ChampSaisie(
          libelle: 'PERSONNES.FIRSTNAME_LABEL',
          longueurMax: 20,
          valeur: valeurs['prenom'] as String,
          onChanged: (v) => onChanged('prenom', v),
          erreur: erreurs['prenom'],
        ),
        ChampSaisie(
          libelle: 'PERSONNES.LASTNAME_LABEL',
          longueurMax: 20,
          valeur: valeurs['nom'] as String,
          onChanged: (v) => onChanged('nom', v),
          erreur: erreurs['nom'],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

The identity fields (title, first name, last name), common to the ADMIN forms, the account creation form, and the “Manage My Account” form.

  • Line 21: The parent passes the values and errors to the UNE function to modify any field;
  • Lines 33–42: The title, in a drop-down list, with label and error message, like an input field. [initialValue] is read only when the field is created; the key ([ValueKey]) recreates it if the value changes via code.

// lib/widgets/champ_captcha.dart - the CAPTCHA image and the input field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A display widget: the image (SVG), the "Other image" button
// (onRecharger), and the field, CONTRÔLÉ, via the parent form (value,

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

    super.key,

The CAPTCHA image, the “Other image” button, and the field. The widget does not call the server: the login screen requests the image because it needs its identifier to send the response.

// =========================================================================
// lib/widgets/confirmation.dart - “Are you sure?”
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Taken from Example 16. The message is a translation CLÉ:
//      if (await confirm(context, 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) { ... }
// "No, go back" rather than "Cancel": the question is sometimes “Cancel this
// appointment?", and a "Cancel" button would be ambiguous in this context. The focus is on
// "No": accidentally pressing Enter doesn't delete anything.
// A new prompt clears the messages from the previous action.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';

Future<bool> confirmer(BuildContext context, String cle) async {
  context.read<Messages>().effacer();
  final t = context.read<Traductions>().t;
  final oui = await showDialog<bool>(
    context: context,
    builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
      title: Text(t('CONFIRMATION.TITLE')),
      content: Text(t(cle)),
      actions: [
        TextButton(autofocus: true, onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false), child: Text(t('CONFIRMATION.NO'))),
        FilledButton(
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
          child: Text(t('CONFIRMATION.YES')),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
  return oui ?? false;
}

The confirmation window from Example 16, translated: [if (await confirmer(context, 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) ...]. The focus is on “No” ([autofocus]): on the web, accidentally pressing Enter does not delete anything.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/widgets/fenetre_reservation.dart - the slot reservation window
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A window above the calendar, including a gray background. It is PAS
// created by showDialog: it is part of the calendar screen, which
// displays it when its ADRESSE requests it (/agenda?...&reserver=7, see
// pages/agenda.dart). The address therefore describes the entire screen, including the window.
//
// The widget does not communicate with the server: it calls
//    - onConfirmer, with the selected patient (null for a patient who is booking
//      for themselves);
//    - onFermer.
// The calendar screen determines what to do with this.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/types.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';

class FenetreReservation extends StatefulWidget {
  final String horaire; // "8:00 - 8:20"
  final List<Personne> clients; // ADMIN / DOCTOR: the patients to choose from
  final String? patient; // USER: the patient is the patient themselves
  final bool envoiEnCours;
  final ValueChanged<int?> onConfirmer;
  final VoidCallback onFermer;

  const FenetreReservation({
    super.key,
    required this.horaire,
    required this.clients,
    required this.patient,
    required this.envoiEnCours,
    required this.onConfirmer,
    required this.onFermer,
  });

  @override
  State<FenetreReservation> createState() => _FenetreReservationState();
}

class _FenetreReservationState extends State<FenetreReservation> {
  int? _idClient;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final patient = widget.patient;
    return Stack(
      children: [
         // ModalBarrier: the background is grayed out; tapping closes the window
        ModalBarrier(color: Colors.black54, onDismiss: widget.onFermer),
        Center(
          child: Card(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  Text(t('BOOKING_DIALOG.TITLE'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(t('BOOKING_DIALOG.SLOT', {'horaire': widget.horaire})),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                   // A patient makes a reservation for himself: no list (and the server
                   // would ignore any potential idClient anyway)
                  if (patient != null)
                    Text.rich(
                      TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          TextSpan(text: '${t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL')} : '),
                          TextSpan(
                            text: patient,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    )
                  else
                    DropdownButtonFormField<int?>(
                      initialValue: _idClient,
                      isExpanded: true,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: t('BOOKING_DIALOG.PATIENT_LABEL')),
                      items: [
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text(t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CHOOSE_PATIENT'))),
                        for (final c in widget.clients) DropdownMenuItem(value: c.id, child: Text(c.libelle)),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (id) => setState(() => _idClient = id),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 20),
                   // OverflowBar: buttons side by side, or one below the other if they don’t fit
                  OverflowBar(
                    alignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
                    spacing: 8,
                    children: [
                      TextButton(onPressed: widget.onFermer, child: Text(t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CANCEL'))),
                      FilledButton(
                        onPressed: widget.envoiEnCours ? null : () => widget.onConfirmer(_idClient),
                        child: Text(t('BOOKING_DIALOG.CONFIRM')),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

The slot reservation window. It is not opened by PAS: it is part of the calendar screen, which displays it when its address requests it ([&reserver=7]).

  • Lines 23–28: The widget does not communicate with the server; it receives the data it displays, along with two functions called to confirm (with the selected patient) or close;
  • lines 51–54: A [Stack] overlays its children: first, a [ModalBarrier]—with a grayed-out background—that covers the entire screen and blocks taps intended for the calendar (tapping closes the window), followed by the window itself, centered;
  • lines 70–91: A patient makes a reservation for themselves: their name, without a list. Either the ADMIN or the doctor selects the patient from a drop-down list; the selection determines the window’s state;
  • lines 95–102: the buttons ([OverflowBar]: side by side, or one below the other if they don’t fit); “Confirm” is disabled during submission.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/connexion.dart - the login screen (/login)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same screen as in other clients: username, password, CAPTCHA, and
// a second "Create a Customer Account" button that verifies the MÊME captcha
// before allowing the account creation process to proceed.
//
// /login?login=jbernard: the login field is pre-filled (immediately after the
// account creation).
// After a successful login, this screen does not navigate PAS on its own: the
// session changes, and the router redirects from the login screen
// (to /login?redirect=... or the role’s home page; see routeur.dart).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../etat/session.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/champ_captcha.dart';
import '../widgets/champ_saisie.dart';
import '../widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';

class PageConnexion extends StatefulWidget {
  final String login; // the login URL (?login=...)

  const PageConnexion({super.key, this.login = ''});

  @override
  State<PageConnexion> createState() => _PageConnexionState();
}

class _PageConnexionState extends State<PageConnexion> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(_messages);
  late final Map<String, String> _saisie = {'login': widget.login, 'password': '', 'captcha': ''};
  Captcha? _captcha;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _rechargerCaptcha();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

   // a new image: this is required after the CHAQUE attempt, because an image is not
   // can only be used UNE times (the server forgets it as soon as it has verified it)
  Future<void> _rechargerCaptcha() async {
    Captcha? captcha;
    try {
      captcha = await _api.captcha();
    } catch (_) {
      captcha = null; // server unreachable: the connection will fail with a clear message
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _captcha = captcha);
  }

  void _modifier(String champ, String valeur) {
    setState(() => _saisie[champ] = valeur);
    _envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

   // Both buttons follow this sequence: send, then, if that fails,
   // error message and NOUVELLE image
  Future<void> _tenter(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    _messages.effacer();
    final reussi = await _envoi.envoyer(action);
    if (!reussi && mounted) {
      setState(() => _saisie['captcha'] = '');
      await _rechargerCaptcha();
    }
  }

   // If successful, nothing else needs to be done here: the router switches screens
  Future<void> _seConnecter() => _tenter(
    () => context.read<Session>().connecter(
      _saisie['login']!.trim(),
      _saisie['password']!,
      _captcha?.id ?? '',
      _saisie['captcha']!,
    ),
  );

  Future<void> _creerCompte() => _tenter(() async {
    await _api.accesInscription(_captcha?.id ?? '', _saisie['captcha']!);
    if (mounted) context.go('/inscription');
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    return TitrePage(
      cle: 'LOGIN.TITLE',
      child: ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: _envoi,
        builder: (context, _) => ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            Text(t('LOGIN.TITLE'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
             // AutofillGroup: the phone’s password manager can fill out the form
            AutofillGroup(
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  ChampSaisie(
                    libelle: 'LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL',
                    valeur: _saisie['login']!,
                    onChanged: (v) => _modifier('login', v),
                    erreur: _envoi.erreurs['login'],
                    autofill: const [AutofillHints.username],
                  ),
                  ChampSaisie(
                    libelle: 'LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL',
                    secret: true,
                    valeur: _saisie['password']!,
                    onChanged: (v) => _modifier('password', v),
                    erreur: _envoi.erreurs['password'],
                    autofill: const [AutofillHints.password],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            ChampCaptcha(
              svg: _captcha?.svg,
              valeur: _saisie['captcha']!,
              onChanged: (v) => _modifier('captcha', v),
              onRecharger: _rechargerCaptcha,
              erreur: _envoi.erreurs['captcha'],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            FilledButton(onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _seConnecter, child: Text(t('LOGIN.SUBMIT'))),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            OutlinedButton(onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _creerCompte, child: Text(t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT'))),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
              child: Text(
                t('LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP'),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            _ComptesDemo(t: t),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// demo accounts
class _ComptesDemo extends StatelessWidget {
  final String Function(String, [Map<String, Object?>]) t;

  const _ComptesDemo({required this.t});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const code = TextStyle(fontFamily: 'RobotoMono', fontSize: 12);
    final style = Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall!.copyWith(color: Colors.grey.shade700);
    return DefaultTextStyle(
      style: style,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(t('LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS')),
          for (final (comptes, cle) in [
            ('admin', 'LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN'),
            ('pelissier, tatou, dupont', 'LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR'),
            ('martin, durand, bistrou, german', 'LOGIN.DEMO_USER'),
          ])
            Text.rich(
              TextSpan(
                children: [
                  const TextSpan(text: '• '),
                  TextSpan(text: comptes, style: code),
                  TextSpan(text: ' - ${t(cle)}'),
                ],
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

The login screen.

  • Lines 39–43: status: the API access layer and messages (UNE times read, [late]: on first use), form submission, data entry (a [Map]: field name -> value), and the received CAPTCHA;
  • lines 59–66: a new image, when the screen opens, upon request, and after CHAQUE attempts (an image is used only once);
  • lines 76–81: both buttons follow this sequence: submission, then, if unsuccessful, the CAPTCHA is cleared and a new image is displayed;
  • lines 86–93: login. If successful, the screen does nothing else: the session changes, and the router, which is listening for it, exits the login screen (see [routeur.dart]);
  • lines 95–97: “Create a customer account”: the server verifies the CAPTCHA and issues a token (a cookie); the account creation screen then opens;
  • lines 105–106: the screen is reloaded when the submission status changes (in progress, errors);
  • lines 113–129: [AutofillGroup] combines the username and password: the phone’s password manager fills them in together and offers to save the account after login;
  • lines 163–{L:TextSpan(text: ' - '): demo accounts. [for (final (comptes, cle) in [...])]: a loop over a list of records, which are deserialized in the process (example 03).

docs.title: 11.13.2. lib/pages/agenda.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/agenda.dart - the calendar screen (/agenda)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three sections, just like in other clients:
//    1. Selecting the doctor and the day;
//    2. that doctor’s schedule for that day;
//    3. the window for booking an appointment slot.
//
// TOUT The screen state is as follows:
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-            05 the calendar
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-05&reserve= 7 + the reservation window
// The router passes these three parameters to the widget; the screen in DÉDUIT this
// is what it displays, and the user’s actions change the address
// (context.go, context.push). On the web, you can therefore reload the page,
// bookmark it, or use Back/Forward; on a phone, the
// Back button closes the booking window.
//
// What each user sees and can do is determined by the SERVEUR (fields
// patient, me, bookable, idRv for each time slot): the screen simply
// displaying it. A patient does not even see the names of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/cache.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../etat/session.dart';
import '../formatage.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/fenetre_reservation.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';

// the calendar’s address (with or without a booking window)
String adresseAgenda(int? idMedecin, String jour, [int? reserver]) => Uri(
  path: '/agenda',
  queryParameters: {'idMedecin': '${idMedecin ?? ''}', 'jour': jour, 'reserver': ?reserver?.toString()},
).toString();

class PageAgenda extends StatefulWidget {
  final int? idMedecin;
  final String? jour; // as-is in the URL: may be invalid
  final int? reserver;

  const PageAgenda({super.key, this.idMedecin, this.jour, this.reserver});

  @override
  State<PageAgenda> createState() => _PageAgendaState();
}

class _PageAgendaState extends State<PageAgenda> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<List<Personne>>? _medecins;
  List<Personne> _clients = [];
  Future<Agenda>? _agenda;
  bool _envoiEnCours = false;

   // the day: the one from the URL if it’s valid, otherwise today
  bool get _jourInvalide => widget.jour != null && !estUneDateValide(widget.jour!);
  String get _jour => widget.jour != null && !_jourInvalide ? widget.jour! : aujourdhui();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final utilisateur = context.read<Session>().utilisateur;
    _medecins = _cache.lire('medecins', () => _api.lister(TypePersonnes.medecins));
     // patients: only those who have permission to view them (booking window)
    if (utilisateur.estGestionnaire) {
      _cache.lire('clients', () => _api.lister(TypePersonnes.clients)).then((c) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _clients = c);
      }, onError: _messages.afficherErreurApi);
    }
    if (_jourInvalide) {
       // After the screen is built: no other report is modified during a build
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => _messages.afficherErreur('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE'));
    }
    _chargerAgenda();
     // invalidated data (booking, cancellation): the calendar is re-read.
     // Especially useful for the hidden screen SOUS in the appointment booking window (see _confirmerReservation)
    _cache.addListener(_chargerAgenda);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _cache.removeListener(_chargerAgenda);
    super.dispose();
  }

   // The router reuses the screen with a different address (different doctor, different day)
  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PageAgenda ancien) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(ancien);
    if (ancien.idMedecin != widget.idMedecin || ancien.jour != widget.jour) _chargerAgenda();
  }

  void _chargerAgenda() {
    final utilisateur = context.read<Session>().utilisateur;
     // without a doctor in the address, a DOCTOR sees the SON calendar (the server
     // retrieves it from the token); the others see nothing
    final avecAgenda = !_jourInvalide && (widget.idMedecin != null || utilisateur?.role == Role.doctor);
    setState(() {
      _agenda = avecAgenda
          ? _cache.lire('agenda/${widget.idMedecin}/$_jour', () => _api.agenda(widget.idMedecin, _jour))
          : null;
    });
     // a failed read: its message, at the bottom of the screen
    _agenda?.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.afficherErreurApi(e));
  }

   // the server’s version is authoritative: after each action, the calendar is re-read
   // (and the patient’s area, which displays their appointment). The invalidation
   // notifies all active calendar screens, including this one (_chargerAgenda)
  void _recharger() {
    _cache.invalider('mon-espace');
    _cache.invalider('agenda');
  }

  void _fermerReservation(int? idMedecin) {
    if (context.canPop()) {
      context.pop();
    } else {
      context.go(adresseAgenda(idMedecin, _jour));
    }
  }

  Future<void> _confirmerReservation(CreneauAgenda creneau, int? idMedecin, int? idClient) async {
    final gestionnaire = context.read<Session>().utilisateur.estGestionnaire;
    setState(() => _envoiEnCours = true);
    try {
      await _api.reserver(_jour, creneau.id, gestionnaire ? idClient : null);
      _messages.flash(cle: 'AGENDA.BOOKED');
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      if (e.cle == 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
         // no patient selected: the window remains open
        _messages.afficherErreur(e.cle);
        return; // (finally executes anyway)
      }
       // slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment...: the
       // message will appear on the calendar; window closed
      _messages.flash(succes: false, cle: e.cle, params: e.params);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _envoiEnCours = false);
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    _fermerReservation(idMedecin);
    _recharger();
  }

  Future<void> _annuler(CreneauAgenda c) async {
    if (c.idRv == null || !await confirmer(context, 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) return;
    try {
      await _api.annulerRv(c.idRv!);
      _messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      _messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    if (mounted) _recharger();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final traductions = context.watch<Traductions>();
    final t = traductions.t;
    final utilisateur = context.watch<Session>().utilisateur;

    return TitrePage(
      cle: 'AGENDA.PAGE_TITLE',
       // FutureBuilder: the calendar (null until the patient arrives, or if there is none)
      child: FutureBuilder<Agenda>(
        future: _agenda,
        builder: (context, etat) {
          final a = etat.data;
           // The doctor displayed: the one at the address, or the one from the received calendar (DOCTOR)
          final idMedecin = widget.idMedecin ?? a?.medecin.id;
           // the time slot for which the reservation window is open (&reserver=7),
           // only if it can be booked by this user
          final aReserver = a?.creneaux.where((c) => c.id == widget.reserver && c.reservable).firstOrNull;
           // the server's message to the patient who already has an upcoming appointment
           // ("cancel it to book another one") makes no sense if CE
           // appointment is in the displayed calendar: it appears, under its name,
           // along with its “Cancel” button. It is only displayed in the AUTRES calendars
          final info = a != null && !a.creneaux.any((c) => c.moi) ? a.info : null;

          final Widget contenu;
          if (etat.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            contenu = const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            );
          } else if (a != null) {
            contenu = _Agenda(
              agenda: a,
              langue: traductions.langue,
              onReserver: (c) => context.push(adresseAgenda(idMedecin, _jour, c.id)),
              onAnnuler: _annuler,
            );
          } else {
            contenu = Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text(t('AGENDA.EMPTY_STATE')));
          }

          return Stack(
            children: [
              ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                children: [
                   // 1. the selection of the doctor and the day. Its key changes with the address:
                   // Flutter then recreates it, using the new values
                  FutureBuilder<List<Personne>>(
                    future: _medecins,
                    builder: (context, medecins) => _ChoixMedecinJour(
                      key: ValueKey('$idMedecin|$_jour'),
                      medecins: medecins.data ?? const [],
                      idMedecin: idMedecin,
                      jour: _jour,
                      onVoir: (id, jour) => context.go(adresseAgenda(id, jour)),
                    ),
                  ),
                   // Patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button
                  if (info != null)
                    Card(
                      color: Colors.lightBlue.shade50,
                      child: ListTile(
                        title: Text(t(info)),
                        trailing: TextButton(
                          onPressed: () => context.go('/mon-espace'),
                          child: Text(t('APP.MENU_MY_SPACE')),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  contenu,
                ],
              ),
               // 3. The booking window, only if the URL contains &reserve=...
              if (aReserver != null)
                FenetreReservation(
                  horaire: horaire(aReserver),
                  clients: _clients,
                  patient: utilisateur.estPatient ? utilisateur!.nom : null,
                  envoiEnCours: _envoiEnCours,
                  onConfirmer: (idClient) => _confirmerReservation(aReserver, idMedecin, idClient),
                  onFermer: () => _fermerReservation(idMedecin),
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Selecting the doctor and the day: a small form, whose state does not
// is used until the form is submitted. It DÉMARRE with the values from the URL.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _ChoixMedecinJour extends StatefulWidget {
  final List<Personne> medecins;
  final int? idMedecin;
  final String jour;
  final void Function(int? idMedecin, String jour) onVoir;

  const _ChoixMedecinJour({
    super.key,
    required this.medecins,
    required this.idMedecin,
    required this.jour,
    required this.onVoir,
  });

  @override
  State<_ChoixMedecinJour> createState() => _ChoixMedecinJourState();
}

class _ChoixMedecinJourState extends State<_ChoixMedecinJour> {
  late int? _idMedecin = widget.idMedecin;
  late String _jour = widget.jour;

  Future<void> _choisirJour() async {
    final choix = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: DateTime.parse(_jour),
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2035, 12, 31),
    );
    if (choix != null) setState(() => _jour = versJour(choix));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final traductions = context.watch<Traductions>();
    final t = traductions.t;
     // The selected doctor must be on the list (otherwise: none)
    final idConnu = widget.medecins.any((m) => m.id == _idMedecin) ? _idMedecin : null;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            DropdownButtonFormField<int?>(
              key: ValueKey('${widget.medecins.length}/$idConnu'),
              initialValue: idConnu,
              isExpanded: true,
              decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DOCTOR_LABEL')),
              items: [
                DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text(t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.CHOOSE_DOCTOR'))),
                for (final m in widget.medecins) DropdownMenuItem(value: m.id, child: Text(m.libelle)),
              ],
              onChanged: (id) => setState(() => _idMedecin = id),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
             // The day: a button that opens the calendar
            InputDecorator(
              decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.DAY_LABEL')),
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: _choisirJour,
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(child: Text(jourLong(_jour, traductions.langue))),
                    const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: idConnu == null ? null : () => widget.onVoir(idConnu, _jour),
              child: Text(t('DOCTOR_DAY_PICKER.VIEW_AGENDA')),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. The schedule
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Agenda extends StatelessWidget {
  final Agenda agenda;
  final String langue;
  final ValueChanged<CreneauAgenda> onReserver;
  final ValueChanged<CreneauAgenda> onAnnuler;

  const _Agenda({required this.agenda, required this.langue, required this.onReserver, required this.onAnnuler});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final a = agenda;
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            ListTile(
              title: Text(
                 '${t('AGENDA.TITLE_PREFIX')} ${jourLong(a.jour, language)}',
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
              subtitle: Text(a.medecin.libelle),
            ),
            if (a.creneaux.isEmpty) Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text(t('AGENDA.NO_SLOTS'))),
            for (final c in a.creneaux) ...[
              const Divider(height: 1),
              ListTile(
                 // Bookable time slots are lightly highlighted
                tileColor: c.reservable ? Colors.green.shade50 : null,
                leading: SizedBox(
                  width: 96,
                  child: Text(horaire(c), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                ),
                title: Align(
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: c.libre
                      ? _Etiquette(t('AGENDA.FREE'), Colors.green.shade700)
                      : c.patient != null
                      ? _Etiquette(c.patient!.libelle, c.moi ? Colors.indigo : Colors.grey.shade600)
                      : _Etiquette(t('AGENDA.BOOKED_BY_OTHER'), Colors.grey.shade600),
                ),
                 // "Reserve" changes the ADRESSE (&reserver=...), which opens the reservation window
                trailing: c.reservable
                    ? OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => onReserver(c), child: Text(t('AGENDA.BOOK')))
                    : c.idRv != null
                    ? OutlinedButton(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                        onPressed: () => onAnnuler(c),
                        child: Text(t('AGENDA.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')),
                      )
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// a colored label (the "badge" of other customers)
class _Etiquette extends StatelessWidget {
  final String texte;
  final Color couleur;

  const _Etiquette(this.texte, this.couleur);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(color: couleur, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6)),
      child: Text(
        texte,
        style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
      ),
    );
  }
}

The most feature-rich screen: selecting a doctor and a day, the calendar, and the booking window.

  • lines 40–43: the calendar’s address. TOUT The screen’s state is contained in its address; user actions change it, and the screen determines what to display based on that;
  • Lines 66–67: The day from the address, if valid; otherwise, today;
  • lines 70–87: When the screen opens: the doctors (from the cache—they are loaded once for the entire session), the patients if the user has permission to view them (for the booking window), and the calendar. If the date in the address is invalid: a message is displayed; APRÈS builds the screen ([addPostFrameCallback]: another state is not modified during screen construction). Finally, the screen reads from the cache;
  • lines 98–100: “View Calendar” changes the address; the router sends RÉUTILISE to the screen (same route) with new parameters: [didUpdateWidget] then re-reads the calendar;
  • lines 103–114: the cache reads the schedule. If there is no doctor listed in the address, a logged-in doctor sees the schedule via SON (the server retrieves it using the token);
  • lines 120–122: After a booking or cancellation, the server’s data takes precedence: the calendar (and the patient’s space) is invalidated; the cache notifies the calendar screens, which reload;
  • lines 125–129: Close the window: return to the previous URL. “Book” has the URL EMPILÉ with [&reserver=] ([context.push]): it is backtracked ([context.pop]), exactly as the phone’s Back button does. If the screen was opened directly at this address (on the web), there is nothing to backtrack: it goes to the calendar address;
  • lines 133–153: the appointment booking. If no patient is selected, the window remains open, displaying the message. Any other action closes the window, and the message (success or error—such as a time slot being taken in the meantime...) appears as a pop-up message for the calendar. The calendar screen containing the window disappears; the one underneath reappears, thanks to the cache;
  • lines 156–164: cancellation, after confirmation;
  • lines 176–184: the screen displays the calendar ([FutureBuilder]). The time slot in the booking window is that of the address ([&reserver=7]), only if it is bookable: PAR, CET, UTILISATEUR (a time slot taken in the meantime, a manually created address: no window);
  • line 189: the server sends this message ([info]) along with TOUS (the calendars); but in the calendar containing the patient’s appointment (a time slot [moi]), it is unnecessary—and even misleading—immediately after a booking: the patient sees their appointment, listed under their name, with a “Cancel” button. Therefore, it is only displayed in the other calendars. [a.creneaux.any((c) => c.moi)]: true if at least one time slot meets the condition;
  • lines 201–202: “Book” sets the window’s address;
  • lines 215–222: selection of the doctor and the day. Its key contains the doctor and the day from the URL: when the URL changes (browser’s Back or Previous button), [Flutter] recreates the widget, which starts over with the new values;
  • lines 226–233: a patient who already has an upcoming appointment: why there is no “Book” button (see [info], above);
  • lines 241–248: the booking window, above the calendar (in [Stack]);
  • Lines 280–291: Selection of the doctor and the day: a short form, specifically record DÉMARRE, containing the address values. [late int? _idMedecin = widget.idMedecin;]: a field initialized from [widget], made possible by [late]. [showDatePicker] opens the calendar from [Material] in the application’s language;
  • lines 319–326: the day is displayed as an input field ([InputDecorator]: the label and border of a field, surrounding any widget), which you tap to open the calendar;
  • lines 346–406: the schedule. One line per time slot: the time, a label (custom text, the patient’s name, or “Reserved” for another patient), and the button enabled by SERVEUR ([reservable], [idRv]).
