docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/personnes_config.dart - doctors or clients?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The screens for managing doctors and clients are IDENTIQUES: same
// list, same form. They are written UNE times (personnes.dart,
// personne_formulaire.dart); the only things that change are the API address and the
// label keys, as described here. The router passes the type to each screen.
// =========================================================================

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';

typedef ClesPersonnes = ({
  String titre, // "Doctors"
  String ajouter, // "Add a doctor"
  String modifier, // "Edit a doctor"
  String vide, // "No doctors."
  String confirmerSuppression,
  String ajoute, // "The doctor {{name}} has been added (login: {{login}})."
  String modifie,
  String supprime,
  String introuvable, // The record has been deleted in the meantime
});

ClesPersonnes cles(TypePersonnes type) => switch (type) {
  TypePersonnes.medecins => (
    titre: 'MEDECINS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'MEDECINS.ADD',
    modifier: 'MEDECINS.EDIT',
    vide: 'MEDECINS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'MEDECINS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'MEDECINS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'MEDECINS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'MEDECINS.DELETED',
    introuvable: 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND',
  ),
  TypePersonnes.clients => (
    titre: 'CLIENTS.TITLE',
    ajouter: 'CLIENTS.ADD',
    modifier: 'CLIENTS.EDIT',
    vide: 'CLIENTS.EMPTY',
    confirmerSuppression: 'CLIENTS.DELETE_CONFIRM',
    ajoute: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',
    supprime: 'CLIENTS.DELETED',
    introuvable: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND',
  ),
};

// {{name}} and {{login}} for "added / edited / deleted" messages
Map<String, String> parametres(Personne p) => {'nom': '${p.prenom} ${p.nom}', 'login': p.login ?? ''};

The screens for doctors and clients are identical; only the label keys, described here, differ.

  • lines 13–22: a record with named fields, which contains the keys for a type of person;
  • lines 25–37: an expression on an enumeration: [Dart] ensures that all cases are handled. Adding a value to [TypePersonnes] would cause a compilation error here;
  • line 51: the parameters for the “added,” “modified,” and “deleted” messages.

docs.title: 11.13.4. lib/pages/personnes.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/personnes.dart - the list of doctors OU for clients (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A single screen for both: the type (doctors or clients) is specified in
// parameter (see routeur.dart); the labels specific to each are in
// personnes_config.dart.
// On a phone, a five-column table doesn’t fit: a row of
// list per person (name, login), with its two buttons; the round button
// "+" button (FloatingActionButton) adds a person.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/cache.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';
import 'personnes_config.dart';

class PagePersonnes extends StatefulWidget {
  final TypePersonnes type;

  const PagePersonnes({super.key, required this.type});

  @override
  State<PagePersonnes> createState() => _PagePersonnesState();
}

class _PagePersonnesState extends State<PagePersonnes> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<List<Personne>>? _liste;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _charger();
  }

   // The router reuses the screen for the other type (/doctors -> /clients)
  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PagePersonnes ancien) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(ancien);
    if (ancien.type != widget.type) _charger();
  }

  void _charger() {
    final type = widget.type;
    setState(() {
      _liste = _cache.lire(type.name, () => _api.lister(type));
    });
    _liste!.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.afficherErreurApi(e));
  }

  Future<void> _supprimer(Personne p) async {
    final c = cles(widget.type);
    if (!await confirmer(context, c.confirmerSuppression)) return;
    try {
      await _api.supprimer(widget.type, p.id);
      _messages.afficherSucces(c.supprime, parametres(p));
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
       // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
      _messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    _cache.invalider(widget.type.name);
    if (mounted) _charger();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final c = cles(widget.type);
    final type = widget.type.name;
    return TitrePage(
      cle: c.titre,
       // A Scaffold DANS template: for its floating button
      child: Scaffold(
        floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
          onPressed: () => context.go('/$type/ajouter'),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
          label: Text(t(c.ajouter)),
        ),
        body: FutureBuilder<List<Personne>>(
          future: _liste,
          builder: (context, etat) {
            final liste = etat.data;
            if (liste == null) {
               // not yet loaded (or loading failed: the message is at the bottom of the screen)
              return etat.hasError ? const SizedBox.shrink() : const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
            }
            return ListView(
               // space at the bottom, so as not to hide the last line under the floating button
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 8, 8, 88),
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  child: Text(t(c.titre), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
                ),
                if (liste.isEmpty) ListTile(title: Text(t(c.vide))),
                for (final p in liste)
                  Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${p.prenom[0]}${p.nom[0]}')),
                      title: Text(p.libelle),
                      subtitle: Text(p.login ?? '', style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'RobotoMono')),
                      trailing: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          IconButton(
                            tooltip: t('PERSONNES.EDIT'),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit),
                            onPressed: () => context.go('/$type/${p.id}/modifier'),
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            tooltip: t('PERSONNES.DELETE'),
                            icon: Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: Colors.red.shade700),
                            onPressed: () => _supprimer(p),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

The list of doctors or clients.

  • lines 54–59: the list, from the cache. Be careful with the curly braces in [setState(() { ... })]: written with an arrow, [setState(() => _liste = ...)]; the function RENVERRAIT returns the assigned value, in this case a [Future], and [setState] rejects a function that returns a [Future] (the status update must be synchronous): [Flutter] signals this with an error;
  • lines 62–73: deletion, after confirmation. A doctor with appointments is rejected by the server (409 [DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS]);
  • lines 84–88: a [Scaffold] within the template’s [Scaffold], for its floating “+ Add” button ([FloatingActionButton]) in the lower right corner;
  • lines 107–124: one list item per person ([ListTile]): an avatar with their initials, name, username, and two buttons. A five-column table, such as the one for web clients, would not fit on a phone.

docs.title: 11.13.5. lib/pages/personne_formulaire.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/personne_formulaire.dart - creation OU modification of a
// doctor or a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//      /doctors/add           -> creation (no ID)
//      /doctors/3/edit        -> edit (ID = 3)
// (and the same URLs under /clients).
//
// Two widgets:
//    - PagePersonneFormulaire reads the record to be edited (if there is one);
//    - _Formulaire is displayed only after the record has been read: it DÉMARRE with
//      its values (initial state), without having to retype them later.
// No rules are checked here: the server validates everything, and any errors
// are displayed below the fields (see widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart).
// The VERSION read from the record is sent back with the modification: if another
// ADMIN has modified it in the meantime, the server responds with a 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/cache.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/champ_saisie.dart';
import '../widgets/champs_personne.dart';
import '../widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';
import 'personnes_config.dart';

const _vide = <String, Object?>{'titre': 'Mr', 'prenom': '', 'nom': '', 'login': '', 'password': ''};

class PagePersonneFormulaire extends StatefulWidget {
  final TypePersonnes type;
  final int? id; // null: creation

  const PagePersonneFormulaire({super.key, required this.type, this.id});

  @override
  State<PagePersonneFormulaire> createState() => _PagePersonneFormulaireState();
}

class _PagePersonneFormulaireState extends State<PagePersonneFormulaire> {
  Future<Personne>? _fiche;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final id = widget.id;
    if (id != null) {
       // modification: the record (including its version) is read; SANS cache: it
       // must be up to date (otherwise the form would start with a version
       // that is out of date: 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE)
      _fiche = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>().lire(widget.type, id);
       // record does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): return to the list
      _fiche!.then(
        (_) {},
        onError: (Object e) {
          if (e is! ErreurApi || !mounted) return;
          context.read<Messages>().flash(succes: false, cle: e.cle, params: e.params);
          context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
        },
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = cles(widget.type);
    return TitrePage(
      cle: widget.id == null ? c.ajouter : c.modifier,
      child: widget.id == null
          ? _Formulaire(type: widget.type, id: null, initial: _vide)
          : FutureBuilder<Personne>(
              future: _fiche,
              builder: (context, etat) {
                final p = etat.data;
                if (p == null) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                return _Formulaire(
                  type: widget.type,
                  id: p.id,
                  initial: {
                    'titre': p.titre,
                    'prenom': p.prenom,
                    'nom': p.nom,
                    'login': p.login ?? '',
                    'password': '',
                    'version': p.version,
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
    );
  }
}

// the form itself
class _Formulaire extends StatefulWidget {
  final TypePersonnes type;
  final int? id;
  final Map<String, Object?> initial;

  const _Formulaire({required this.type, required this.id, required this.initial});

  @override
  State<_Formulaire> createState() => _FormulaireState();
}

class _FormulaireState extends State<_Formulaire> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(_messages);
   // an editable COPIE with default values
  late final Map<String, Object?> _saisie = {...widget.initial};

  bool get _creation => widget.id == null;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _modifier(String champ, String valeur) {
    setState(() => _saisie[champ] = valeur);
    _envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  Future<void> _enregistrer() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final cache = context.read<Cache>();
    final c = cles(widget.type);
    final reussi = await _envoi.envoyer(() async {
      final id = widget.id;
      final p = id == null ? await api.ajouter(widget.type, _saisie) : await api.modifier(widget.type, id, _saisie);
      _messages.flash(cle: _creation ? c.ajoute : c.modifie, params: parametres(p));
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    final cle = _messages.erreur?.cle;
    if (reussi) {
      cache.invalider(widget.type.name); // the list has changed
      context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
    } else if (cle == c.introuvable) {
       // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: back to the list
      _messages.flash(succes: false, cle: cle!);
      context.go('/${widget.type.name}');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    final c = cles(widget.type);
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _envoi,
      builder: (context, _) => ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Text(t(_creation ? c.ajouter : c.modifier), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          ChampsPersonne(valeurs: _saisie, erreurs: _envoi.erreurs, onChanged: _modifier),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
          ChampSaisie(
            libelle: 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL',
            longueurMax: 30,
            valeur: _saisie['login'] as String,
            onChanged: (v) => _modifier('login', v),
            erreur: _envoi.erreurs['login'],
            aide: _creation ? 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_HELP_EDIT',
          ),
           // never pre-filled: the password is never returned from the server
          ChampSaisie(
            libelle: 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL',
            secret: true,
            longueurMax: 72,
            valeur: _saisie['password'] as String,
            onChanged: (v) => _modifier('password', v),
            erreur: _envoi.erreurs['password'],
            params: _envoi.params,
            aide: _creation ? 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_CREATE' : 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Wrap(
            spacing: 8,
            children: [
              FilledButton(onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _enregistrer, child: Text(t('PERSONNES.SAVE'))),
              OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/${widget.type.name}'), child: Text(t('PERSONNES.BACK'))),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

Adding or modifying a doctor or a client.

  • lines 54–65: To make a change, the record is read; SANS cache: its version must be up to date. If a record cannot be found (deleted in the meantime): return to the list with a message;
  • lines 78–92: The form is displayed only after the record has been read, along with DÉMARRE and its values; the user never has to re-enter them later;
  • line 117: a COPIE that can be modified from the initial values ([...]: the decomposition operator, within a [Map]);
  • lines 132–149: the record: [POST] or [PUT], depending on whether there is an identifier. The success message is a flash message: it will appear on the list. If a record has been deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list;
  • lines 167–184: the username and password, with different help messages for creation and modification (leaving the password field blank does not change the password). The password is never pre-filled: the server never returns it.

docs.title: 11.13.6. lib/pages/inscription.dart
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/inscription.dart - "Create a customer account" (/registration)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// You can only get here after entering the CAPTCHA from the login screen
// ("Create a Customer Account" button): the server then issued a
// pass (a cookie), which the highway patrol officer verified (see
// routeur.dart). Same fields as the form in ADMIN, but the login
// and password are required, with confirmation.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/champ_saisie.dart';
import '../widgets/champs_personne.dart';
import '../widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the error PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT)
const motDePasseMin = '6';

class PageInscription extends StatefulWidget {
  const PageInscription({super.key});

  @override
  State<PageInscription> createState() => _PageInscriptionState();
}

class _PageInscriptionState extends State<PageInscription> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(_messages);
  final Map<String, Object?> _saisie = {
    'titre': 'Mr',
    'prenom': '',
    'nom': '',
    'login': '',
    'password': '',
    'confirmation': '',
  };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _modifier(String champ, String valeur) {
    setState(() => _saisie[champ] = valeur);
    _envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  Future<void> _creer() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    var login = '';
    final reussi = await _envoi.envoyer(() async => login = await api.inscrire(_saisie));
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (reussi) {
       // Return to the login screen, login pre-filled
      _messages.flash(cle: 'INSCRIPTION.DONE', params: {'login': login});
      context.go(Uri(path: '/login', queryParameters: {'login': login}).toString());
    } else if (_messages.erreur?.cle == 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
       // pass expired (15 minutes): return to CAPTCHA
      _messages.flash(succes: false, cle: 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
      context.go('/login');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
     // help message parameters for password errors (ET)
    final paramsPassword = {'min': motDePasseMin, ..._envoi.params};
    return TitrePage(
      cle: 'INSCRIPTION.TITLE',
      child: ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: _envoi,
        builder: (context, _) => ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            Text(t('INSCRIPTION.TITLE'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),
            Text(t('INSCRIPTION.INTRO'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ChampsPersonne(valeurs: _saisie, erreurs: _envoi.erreurs, onChanged: _modifier),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
            ChampSaisie(
              libelle: 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL',
              longueurMax: 30,
              valeur: _saisie['login'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _modifier('login', v),
              erreur: _envoi.erreurs['login'],
              aide: 'INSCRIPTION.LOGIN_HELP',
              autofill: const [AutofillHints.newUsername],
            ),
            ChampSaisie(
              libelle: 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_LABEL',
              secret: true,
              longueurMax: 72,
              valeur: _saisie['password'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _modifier('password', v),
              erreur: _envoi.erreurs['password'],
              params: paramsPassword,
              aide: 'INSCRIPTION.PASSWORD_HELP',
              autofill: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
            ),
            ChampSaisie(
              libelle: 'COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL',
              secret: true,
              longueurMax: 72,
              valeur: _saisie['confirmation'] as String,
              onChanged: (v) => _modifier('confirmation', v),
              erreur: _envoi.erreurs['confirmation'],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                FilledButton(onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _creer, child: Text(t('INSCRIPTION.SUBMIT'))),
                OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/login'), child: Text(t('INSCRIPTION.BACK_TO_LOGIN'))),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

Creating a patient account, accessible with the pass issued by the login screen (see “The Highway Patrolman” in [routeur.dart]).

  • line 25: the minimum password length; for the help message: the same value as the server (which also returns it with error [PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT]);
  • Lines 57–69: Creation. Successful: returns to the login screen, with the username pre-filled ([/login?login=...]), along with a pop-up message. Failed because the pass has expired (15 minutes): returns to the CAPTCHA. Any other error remains displayed below the fields;
  • line 77: the parameters for the help message and the password error ([{{min}}]);
  • lines 98–109: a NOUVEAU account: the password manager can suggest a strong password and save it.

// lib/pages/espace_patient.dart - "My Space" (/my-space, role USER)

// The patient’s home screen, immediately after logging in:
//    - two options: [Gérer mon compte] and [Voir un agenda];
//    - their upcoming appointment, if they have one, along with the option to cancel it.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/erreur_api.dart';
import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/cache.dart';

import '../formatage.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';

import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';
import 'agenda.dart';

class PageEspacePatient extends StatefulWidget {
  const PageEspacePatient({super.key});

  @override
  State<PageEspacePatient> createState() => _PageEspacePatientState();
}

class _PageEspacePatientState extends State<PageEspacePatient> {
  late final _api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
  late final _cache = context.read<Cache>();
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  Future<MonEspace>? _espace;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _charger();
  }

  void _charger() {
     // curly braces: an arrow function RENVERRAIT, the assigned Future, and
     // setState rejects a function that returns a Future
    setState(() {
      _espace = _cache.lire('mon-espace', _api.monEspace);
    });
    _espace!.then((_) {}, onError: (Object e) => _messages.afficherErreurApi(e));
  }

  Future<void> _annuler(int idRv) async {
    if (!await confirmer(context, 'AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM')) return;
    try {
      await _api.annulerRv(idRv);
      _messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      _messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
     // the ET space—the schedules have changed
    _cache.invalider('mon-espace');
    _cache.invalider('agenda');
    if (mounted) _charger();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final traductions = context.watch<Traductions>();
    final t = traductions.t;
    return TitrePage(
      cle: 'ESPACE.TITLE',
      child: FutureBuilder<MonEspace>(
        future: _espace,
        builder: (context, etat) {
          final e = etat.data;
          if (e == null) return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          return ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                child: Text(
                  t('ESPACE.HELLO', {'nom': e.patient.libelle}),
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,
                ),
              ),
              _Option(
                icone: Icons.manage_accounts,
                titre: t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT'),
                aide: t('ESPACE.MANAGE_ACCOUNT_HELP'),
                onTap: () => context.go('/mon-compte'),
              ),
              _Option(
                icone: Icons.calendar_month,
                titre: t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA'),
                aide: t('ESPACE.VIEW_AGENDA_HELP'),
                onTap: () => context.go('/agenda'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(t('ESPACE.MY_APPOINTMENT'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium),
                       // normally just one ("an upcoming appointment at
                       // time”), but the screen can display multiple ones
                      for (final rv in e.rendezVous) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 8),
                        Text(
                           '${jourLong(rv.jour, traductions.langue)}, ${schedule(rv.creneau)}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                        Text(rv.medecin.libelle),
                        Wrap(
                          spacing: 8,
                          children: [
                             // the doctor’s schedule for that day: the patient sees their name there
                            TextButton(
                              onPressed: () => context.go(adresseAgenda(rv.medecin.id, rv.jour)),
                              child: Text(t('ESPACE.SEE_IN_AGENDA')),
                            ),
                            OutlinedButton(
                              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                              onPressed: () => _annuler(rv.id),
                              child: Text(t('ESPACE.CANCEL_APPOINTMENT')),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                      if (e.rendezVous.isEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                          child: Text(t('ESPACE.NO_APPOINTMENT'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

// an options “card” that you tap to open a screen
class _Option extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icone;
  final String titre;
  final String aide;

  const _Option({required this.icone, required this.titre, required this.aide, required this.onTap});

Patient check-in: two options, and their upcoming appointment.

  • lines 52–63: Canceling the appointment: the ET section—the schedules have changed;
  • Lines 109–127: the appointment, and two buttons: view the doctor’s schedule for that day (the patient sees their name there), cancel;

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/pages/mon_compte.dart - "Manage My Account" (/my-account, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two separate forms:
//    1. editing (identity, login, optional new password);
//    2. account deletion—which also cancels any scheduled appointments.
// Both require the password ACTUEL (verified by the server).
// Two forms, so two EnvoiFormulaire (two sets of errors). As
// for the people form, the change is displayed only
// time the account is read, and starts with its values.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../api/rdvmedecins_api.dart';
import '../api/types.dart';
import '../etat/cache.dart';
import '../etat/messages.dart';
import '../etat/session.dart';
import '../i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../widgets/champ_saisie.dart';
import '../widgets/champs_personne.dart';
import '../widgets/confirmation.dart';
import '../widgets/envoi_formulaire.dart';
import '../widgets/titre_page.dart';

class PageMonCompte extends StatefulWidget {
  const PageMonCompte({super.key});

  @override
  State<PageMonCompte> createState() => _PageMonCompteState();
}

class _PageMonCompteState extends State<PageMonCompte> {
   // re-read on every visit, without caching: its version must be up to date
  late final Future<MonCompte> _compte = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>().monCompte();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return TitrePage(
      cle: 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE',
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          FutureBuilder<MonCompte>(
            future: _compte,
            builder: (context, etat) => etat.hasData
                ? _Modification(compte: etat.data!)
                : const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                    child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
                  ),
          ),
          const _Suppression(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. the change
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Modification extends StatefulWidget {
  final MonCompte compte;

  const _Modification({required this.compte});

  @override
  State<_Modification> createState() => _ModificationState();
}

class _ModificationState extends State<_Modification> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(_messages);
  late final Map<String, Object?> _saisie = {
    'titre': widget.compte.titre,
    'prenom': widget.compte.prenom,
    'nom': widget.compte.nom,
    'login': widget.compte.login,
    'password': '',
    'confirmation': '',
    'motDePasseActuel': '',
    'version': widget.compte.version,
  };

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _modifier(String champ, String valeur) {
    setState(() => _saisie[champ] = valeur);
    _envoi.effacerErreur(champ);
  }

  Future<void> _enregistrer() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final session = context.read<Session>();
    final cache = context.read<Cache>();
    final reussi = await _envoi.envoyer(() async {
       // The server issued a NOUVEAU token (name, login): the top bar must update accordingly
      session.mettreAJour(await api.modifierMonCompte(_saisie));
      _messages.flash(cle: 'MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
    });
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (reussi) {
      cache.invalider('mon-espace');
      context.go('/mon-espace');
    } else {
       // Never leave a password in the field after a submission is rejected;
       // Change the value SANS to pass through _modifier(), so as not to clear it
       // the error that the server just attached to it
      setState(() => _saisie['motDePasseActuel'] = '');
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _envoi,
      builder: (context, _) => Card(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(t('MON_COMPTE.TITLE'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),
              ChampsPersonne(valeurs: _saisie, erreurs: _envoi.erreurs, onChanged: _modifier),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(t('PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION'), style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
              ChampSaisie(
                libelle: 'PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL',
                longueurMax: 30,
                valeur: _saisie['login'] as String,
                onChanged: (v) => _modifier('login', v),
                erreur: _envoi.erreurs['login'],
              ),
              ChampSaisie(
                libelle: 'MON_COMPTE.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL',
                secret: true,
                longueurMax: 72,
                valeur: _saisie['password'] as String,
                onChanged: (v) => _modifier('password', v),
                erreur: _envoi.erreurs['password'],
                params: _envoi.params,
                aide: 'PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT',
              ),
              ChampSaisie(
                libelle: 'COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL',
                secret: true,
                longueurMax: 72,
                valeur: _saisie['confirmation'] as String,
                onChanged: (v) => _modifier('confirmation', v),
                erreur: _envoi.erreurs['confirmation'],
              ),
              ChampSaisie(
                libelle: 'MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL',
                secret: true,
                longueurMax: 72,
                valeur: _saisie['motDePasseActuel'] as String,
                onChanged: (v) => _modifier('motDePasseActuel', v),
                erreur: _envoi.erreurs['motDePasseActuel'],
                aide: 'MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP',
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 8,
                children: [
                  FilledButton(onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _enregistrer, child: Text(t('PERSONNES.SAVE'))),
                  OutlinedButton(onPressed: () => context.go('/mon-espace'), child: Text(t('MON_COMPTE.BACK'))),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Deletion: a form with a single field
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _Suppression extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Suppression();

  @override
  State<_Suppression> createState() => _SuppressionState();
}

class _SuppressionState extends State<_Suppression> {
  late final _messages = context.read<Messages>();
  late final _envoi = EnvoiFormulaire(_messages);
  String _motDePasseActuel = '';

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _supprimer() async {
    final api = context.read<RdvMedecinsApi>();
    final session = context.read<Session>();
    if (!await confirmer(context, 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM')) return;
    final reussi = await _envoi.envoyer(() => api.supprimerMonCompte(_motDePasseActuel));
    if (reussi) {
       // the message first: it will be displayed on the login screen, where the
       // router takes us as soon as the session is empty
      _messages.flash(cle: 'MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
      session.oublier(volontaire: true); // the server has deleted the token cookie
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = context.watch<Traductions>().t;
    return ListenableBuilder(
      listenable: _envoi,
      builder: (context, _) => Card(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          side: BorderSide(color: Colors.red.shade300),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Text(
                t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE'),
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge!.copyWith(color: Colors.red.shade700),
              ),
              Text(t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP'), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
              ChampSaisie(
                libelle: 'MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL',
                secret: true,
                longueurMax: 72,
                valeur: _motDePasseActuel,
                onChanged: (v) {
                  setState(() => _motDePasseActuel = v);
                  _envoi.effacerErreur('motDePasseActuel');
                },
                erreur: _envoi.erreurs['motDePasseActuel'],
              ),
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red.shade700),
                  onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : _supprimer,
                  child: Text(t('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_SUBMIT')),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

“Manage My Account”: two independent forms, each with its own [EnvoiFormulaire].

  • line 38: the account, reloaded on every visit, without caching (its version must be up to date);
  • lines 100–117: the modification. The server returns the updated user (and a new token in their cookie): the session is updated, and the name displayed in the menu is updated accordingly. After a rejection, the current password is cleared from the field;
  • lines 207–216: account deletion, after confirmation. First, the message (a pop-up message); then the session is cleared, and the router displays the login screen, along with the message.
