docs.title: 9. Communicating with the server
docs.text: The JSON [RdvMedecins] server must now be started (port 8080), as explained in the previous chapter.

docs.title: 9.1.1. Where is the server?
docs.text:
For a web client served by the server itself, the question doesn’t arise: requests are sent to the same origin as the page, using a relative address ([/api/captcha]). A mobile app doesn’t have an origin: you must provide it with the server’s full address. And this address depends on where the app is running:

// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/config.dart - Is OÙ the server JSON?
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// This question doesn’t apply to a web application served by the
// server itself: requests are sent to the origin that the page
// (a relative address, /api/...). But a MOBILE application does not
// origin: you must provide it with the full server address.
//    - The Android emulator sees the computer running it at
//      the address 10.0.2.2 (localhost, which, to the emulator, is the emulator itself);
//    - a real phone, connected to the same Wi-Fi network as the computer, must
//      use the computer’s address on that network (192.168.1.20...):
//      you provide it when launching the app:
//          flutter run --dart-define=SERVEUR=http://192.168.1.20:8080 ...
//    - in web development mode (flutter run -d chrome), the Flutter development server
//      Flutter development server forwards /api requests to the JSON server
//      (file web_dev_config.yaml): a relative address is sufficient;
//    - on a computer (Windows, macOS, Linux): localhost.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

// the value specified by --dart-define=SERVEUR=..., default is '';
// String.fromEnvironment evaluates to COMPILATION: this is a constant
const _serveurImpose = String.fromEnvironment('SERVEUR');

class Config {
   // kIsWeb: true if the app is running in a browser;
   // defaultTargetPlatform: the system (Android, iOS, Windows...)
  static String urlServeur = _serveurImpose.isNotEmpty
      ? _serveurImpose
      : kIsWeb
      ? '' // same origin: relative addresses
      : defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.android
      ? 'http://10.0.2.2:8080'
      : 'http://localhost:8080';
}
  • line 24: an address provided when the app launches, via the option [--dart-define]: [flutter run --dart-define=SERVEUR=http://192.168.1.20:8080 ...]. [String.fromEnvironment] is evaluated at compile time: it is a constant, “”, if the option is not provided;
  • Lines 29–35: otherwise, a default address, depending on the platform. [kIsWeb] is true if the application is running in a browser; [defaultTargetPlatform] indicates which system it is running on ([TargetPlatform.android], [TargetPlatform.windows]...):
    • on the web: a relative address (''), the same origin as the application;
    • on the emulator [Android]: [http://10.0.2.2:8080]. The emulator is a standalone machine with its own network: to the emulator, [localhost] refers to the emulator itself. The special address [10.0.2.2] refers to the computer running it;
    • on a computer ([Windows]...): [http://localhost:8080].

A real phone, connected to the same Wi-Fi network as the server computer, must use the computer’s address on that network (the command [ipconfig] from [Windows] provides it): this is passed via [--dart-define]. The computer’s firewall must also allow incoming connections on port 8080.

Two settings in the [Android] project are required, in the [android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml] file:

<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
     <!-- network access (the server JSON) -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <application
        android:label="exemples_flutter"
        android:name="${applicationName}"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">
  • line 3: permission to use the network. During development, [Flutter] adds this automatically (for hot reloading); it must be explicitly declared for the released application;
  • Line 8: Starting with version 9 of [Android], an application is only allowed to communicate via HTTPS. Our development server uses HTTP (“unencrypted”): we allow this. In production, the server would use HTTPS, and this line would be removed.

And for the web: the [Flutter] ([flutter run -d chrome]) development server serves the application on its own port; the JSON server, on the other hand, is on port 8080. These are two different origins: the browser would refuse to include the cookie in requests and even to read it in responses (the server does not allow requests from a different origin, namely “CORS”). The [web_dev_config.yaml] file configures the [Flutter] web development server (since version 3.38):

# ==========================================================================
# web_dev_config.yaml - the Flutter development server WEB
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `flutter run -d chrome` serves the application at http://localhost:5173 and
# forwards all /api/... requests to the server JSON RdvMedecins (port 8080):
# For the browser, the application, and API, the origin is MÊME (no
# CORS, and the token cookie is passed along). Examples 22 through 25.
# ==========================================================================

server:
  host: localhost
  port: 5173
  proxy:
    - target: "http://localhost:8080/"
      prefix: "/api/"
  • line 12: the web application is served on port 5173;
  • lines 13–15: a proxy: any request to an address beginning with [/api/] is forwarded to the JSON server (port 8080), and its response is sent back to the browser. To the browser, the application and API have the same origin. This is exactly the role of the [Vite] proxy in the [React] course.

docs.title: 9.1.2. The request
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex22_http/main.dart - an initial request HTTP to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server JSON RdvMedecins must be running (port 8080). It is asked to
// a CAPTCHA: GET /api/captcha -> { "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" }.
//
//    - http.get(uri): the function from the http package that sends a request
//      GET. It returns a Future containing the response (http.Response): its
//      status code (statusCode), its headers, and its body;
//    - jsonDecode (text): the body JSON -> Dart objects (Map, List...);
//    - the server address depends on where the application is running
//      (Android emulator, phone, browser, etc.): see common/config.dart;
//    - three states to display: in progress, successful, error;
//    - the CAPTCHA image is from SVG: the flutter_svg package knows how to render it.
// =========================================================================

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

import '../commun/config.dart';

void main() {
  runApp(
    MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo),
      home: const PageCaptcha(),
    ),
  );
}

class PageCaptcha extends StatefulWidget {
  const PageCaptcha({super.key});

  @override
  State<PageCaptcha> createState() => _PageCaptchaState();
}

class _PageCaptchaState extends State<PageCaptcha> {
   // what GET returns from /api/captcha: a record
  ({String id, String svg})? _captcha;
  bool _enCours = true;
  String? _erreur;
  int _nbRequetes = 0;
  int _numeroDemande = 0; // the number of the last request

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _charger(); // the first request, as soon as the screen appears
  }

  Future<void> _charger() async {
    final numero = ++_numeroDemande;
    setState(() {
      _enCours = true;
      _erreur = null;
    });
    try {
      final reponse = await http.get(Uri.parse('${Config.urlServeur}/api/captcha'));
       // http.get does not throw an exception for an error response (4xx,
       // 5xx): the status code is checked
      if (reponse.statusCode != 200) {
        throw Exception('le serveur a répondu ${reponse.statusCode} ${reponse.reasonPhrase}');
      }
      final json = jsonDecode(reponse.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
       // of the response to a request DÉPASSÉE (a new request was sent in the meantime), or
       // arrived after the screen closed: ignore it
      if (!mounted || numero != _numeroDemande) return;
      setState(() {
        _captcha = (id: json['id'] as String, svg: json['svg'] as String);
        _nbRequetes++;
        _enCours = false;
      });
    } catch (e) {
       // no response at all (server down, incorrect address...), or error
      if (!mounted || numero != _numeroDemande) return;
      setState(() {
        _erreur = '$e';
        _captcha = null;
        _enCours = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final captcha = _captcha;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Exemple 22 - une première requête HTTP')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Text(
            'Serveur : ${Config.urlServeur.isEmpty ? '(même origine)' : Config.urlServeur}',
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_enCours) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
          if (_erreur != null)
            Card(
              color: Colors.red.shade50,
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                child: Text(
                  "Impossible d'obtenir un captcha : $_erreur.\n"
                  'Le serveur JSON RdvMedecins est-il lancé (port 8080) ?',
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (captcha != null && !_enCours) ...[
             // SvgPicture.string: draw a given image SVG as text
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
              ),
              child: SvgPicture.string(captcha.svg, height: 60),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text('id : ${captcha.id}', style: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'RobotoMono', fontSize: 11)),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Align(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            child: FilledButton(onPressed: _enCours ? null : _charger, child: const Text('Autre image')),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text('$_nbRequetes requête(s) réussie(s)', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
  • line 21: the [http] packet, the HTTP client from the [Dart] team. [as http]: Its functions are used with a prefix ([http.get], [http.Response]), which prevents their names from being confused with others;
  • lines 44)? _captcha;}-48: the status: the received CAPTCHA (a record, or [null]), the three states of a request (in progress, error, successful), the number of successful requests;
  • lines 51–53: the first request is sent as soon as the screen appears;
  • lines 56–84: the request:
    • line 63: [http.get] sends a request to GET and later returns a [Future<http.Response>]: the response. [Uri.parse] constructs the address from a string;
    • lines 66–67: [http.get] does not throw an exception (PAS) for an error response (4xx, 5xx): it’s just another response. We check its status code;
    • line 69: [reponse.body] is the body of the response, the text; [jsonDecode] converts it into [Dart] objects: in this case, a [Map];
    • line 72: the response to a DÉPASSÉE request (an image was requested again in the meantime), or one that arrives after the screen has closed, is ignored (see Example 19);
    • line 74: JSON is of type [dynamic]: each value is converted to its corresponding type, resulting in [as];
    • lines {L:} catch (e) {}-82: no response at all (server down, incorrect address, network disconnected): [http.get] throws an exception, which is caught and displayed;
  • line 102: a progress bar during the request;
  • line 122: the CAPTCHA image is from SVG, in text form: [SvgPicture.string] (package [flutter_svg]) renders it. It is generated by the NOTRE server and contains nothing provided by a user;
  • line 130: “Other image,” disabled during a request.

On the [Android] emulator; then, with the JSON server shut down:

The [Flutter DevTools] tool (launched by [VS Code], or via the address provided by [flutter run]) has a Network (“Network”) tab that displays each HTTP request from the application, along with its headers and body, similar to a browser’s developer tools.

docs.title: 9.2.1. A HTTP client that handles cookies
docs.text:
The server stores the JWT token in a cookie. In a browser, the browser handles storing and sending cookies; the application code doesn’t need to do anything. On a phone, there is no PAS browser—it’s up to the application to handle this.

// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/client_http.dart - a client HTTP that handles COOKIES
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server RdvMedecins places the token JWT in a COOKIE (httpOnly).
// In a browser, it is the browser that stores cookies and
// sends them back with every request: the application code has nothing to do with it.
// On a phone, there is no PAS browser: it is up to the application to
// fulfill this role, that is:
//    1. read the "Set-Cookie" header in each response and store the cookies;
//    2. send them back in the “Cookie” header of each request.
// This client (HTTP) does this; in ENVELOPPANT, the client in the HTTP package
// (http.BaseClient: simply call the `send` method). The cookies are
// also stored on the device (shared_preferences): you remain logged in
// even when you close and then reopen the app.
// On the web, it does nothing more than a regular client: the
// browser prevents the app from reading or writing these headers.
// =========================================================================

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class ClientAvecCookies extends http.BaseClient {
  static const _cle = 'rdvmedecins.cookies';

  final http.Client _interne = http.Client();
  final SharedPreferences? _stockage;
   // cookie name -> its value
  final Map<String, String> _cookies = {};

  ClientAvecCookies([this._stockage]) {
     // cookies stored from a previous session
    final memorises = _stockage?.getString(_cle);
    if (memorises != null) {
      _cookies.addAll((jsonDecode(memorises) as Map<String, Object?>).cast<String, String>());
    }
  }

  @override
  Future<http.StreamedResponse> send(http.BaseRequest requete) async {
    if (!kIsWeb && _cookies.isNotEmpty) {
       // "rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJhbGci...; other=value"
      requete.headers['cookie'] = [for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in _cookies.entries) '$key=$value'].join('; ');
    }
    final reponse = await _interne.send(requete);
    final setCookie = reponse.headers['set-cookie'];
    if (!kIsWeb && setCookie != null) {
      _memoriser(setCookie);
    }
    return reponse;
  }

   // Set-Cookie: rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJ...; Max-Age=7200; Path=/api; Expires=Tue, Sep 29, 2026 ...; HttpOnly
   // (multiple cookies are separated by commas). We only keep the
   // name and value of each cookie; an empty value (logout) deletes it
  void _memoriser(String setCookie) {
     // a name followed by "=", at the beginning of the header or after a comma
    for (final m in RegExp(r'(?:^|,)\s*([^=;,\s]+)=([^;]*)').allMatches(setCookie)) {
      final nom = m[1]!;
      final valeur = m[2]!.trim();
      if (valeur.isEmpty) {
        _cookies.remove(nom);
      } else {
        _cookies[nom] = valeur;
      }
    }
    _stockage?.setString(_cle, jsonEncode(_cookies));
  }

  @override
  void close() => _interne.close();
}
  • Line 25: The [http] package allows you to wrap your client: You inherit from [http.BaseClient], and all you need to do is implement the [send] method, through which all requests pass ([get], [post]...);
  • lines 28–31: the wrapped client, the device’s storage (optional: [?]), and the cookies (name → value);
  • lines 33–37: upon creation, the cookies stored during a previous use of the app. This keeps you logged in when you close and then reopen the app: on a phone, this is equivalent to a browser retaining its cookies from one visit to the next;
  • lines 42–52: Each request receives the header [Cookie] (“rdvmedecins_jwt=eyJhbGci...; other=value”), then the [Set-Cookie] header from the response is read. [kIsWeb]: On the web, the app does nothing more than a regular client, because the browser prevents the app from reading or writing these headers (it handles them itself);
  • lines 58–69: the [Set-Cookie] header. Several cookies are separated by commas, but the date [Expires] itself contains a comma (“Tue, 29 Sep 2026”): the regular expression matches only a name followed by [=], either at the beginning of the header or after a comma. Only the name and value of each cookie are retained; an empty value (logout: the server sends [rdvmedecins_jwt=; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970...]) deletes the cookie. [_stockage?.setString(...)]: The call is made only if [_stockage] is not [null].

More comprehensive cookie management (domains, paths, expiration dates) is available in packages ([cookie_jar], with the client [dio]); our implementation, consisting of just a few lines, is sufficient for the UN server. Security note: The token is stored in plain text on the device here. A production application would use the [flutter_secure_storage] package (see Example 20).

docs.title: 9.2.2. A command
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex23_connexion/commande.dart - a ACTION, its status, its result
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// An asynchronous action (log in, save...) has a status that
// the screen must display: Is it EN COURS (button disabled, indicator)?
//end with a ERREUR (message)? This is the "Command" template
// from the Flutter architecture guide, stripped down to the essentials:
//
//      final connection = Command();
//      connexion.executer(() => seConnecter(...   )); // triggers the action
//      connexion.enCours, connexion.err            eur // its state
//
// A command is a ChangeNotifier: the screen listens for it (ListenableBuilder)
// and redraws itself when the command starts and when it ends.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

class Commande extends ChangeNotifier {
  bool _enCours = false;
  Object? _erreur;

  bool get enCours => _enCours;
  Object? get erreur => _erreur;

   // executes the action, if another one isn’t already in progress
  Future<void> executer(Future<void> Function() action) async {
    if (_enCours) return; // prevents double-sending (double-tapping the button)
    _enCours = true;
    _erreur = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (e) {
      _erreur = e; // the error is GARDÉE, to be displayed
    } finally {
       // Finally: executed in TOUS in all cases, whether successful or an error
      _enCours = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void effacerErreur() {
    _erreur = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

An asynchronous action (log in, save, etc.) has a status that the screen must display: is it in progress (button disabled)? Did it end with an error (message)? This is the “Command” model from the [Flutter] architecture guide, stripped down to the essentials. The [React] course used the “actions” from [React] 19 ([useActionState]) for this purpose.

  • Lines 27–39: Execute an action: if another action is in progress, do nothing (to prevent double-sending if the button is pressed twice); otherwise, the command changes to “in progress” and notifies its listeners; in the event of an exception, the error is logged for display; in all cases ([finally]), the command is no longer in progress.

docs.title: 9.2.3. The screen
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex23_connexion/main.dart - connect to the server RdvMedecins
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//    1. On startup: GET /api/auth/moi - are we already logged in?
//       (the application may have been shut down; the server, however, reads the cookie
//       that is presented to it);
//    2. login: POST /api/auth/login, body JSON { login, password,
//       captchaId, captcha }. If successful, the server sends the cookie
//       for the token JWT (Set-Cookie header);
//    3. Protected request: GET /api/medecins. The cookie is included in the request;
//    4. Logout: POST /api/auth/logout—the server deletes the cookie.
// On the phone, it is ClientAvecCookies (common/client_http.dart) that
// stores the cookie and sends it back; on the web, this is done by the browser.
// =========================================================================

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../commun/client_http.dart';
import '../commun/config.dart';
import 'commande.dart';

// the few messages this example needs (Example 25 will use dictionaries)
const messages = {
  'LOGIN.ERROR': 'Login ou mot de passe incorrect.',
  'ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA': "Les caractères recopiés ne correspondent pas à l'image.",
  'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS': 'Trop de tentatives infructueuses. Réessayez plus tard.',
};

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final client = ClientAvecCookies(await SharedPreferences.getInstance());
  runApp(
    MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo),
      home: PageConnexion(client: client),
    ),
  );
}

// a response that is not a 2xx becomes an exception, which retains the response
class ReponseEnErreur implements Exception {
  final http.Response reponse;
  const ReponseEnErreur(this.reponse);
}

class PageConnexion extends StatefulWidget {
  final http.Client client;

  const PageConnexion({super.key, required this.client});

  @override
  State<PageConnexion> createState() => _PageConnexionState();
}

class _PageConnexionState extends State<PageConnexion> {
  Map<String, dynamic>? _utilisateur; // null: no one is logged in
  List<dynamic> _medecins = [];
  Map<String, dynamic>? _captcha;
  bool _pret = false; // Is the initial verification complete?
  String? _erreurServeur;
  final _connexion = Commande();
  final _login = TextEditingController(text: 'admin');
  final _password = TextEditingController();
  final _reponseCaptcha = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _verifierSession();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _connexion.dispose();
    _login.dispose();
    _password.dispose();
    _reponseCaptcha.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Uri _url(String chemin) => Uri.parse('${Config.urlServeur}/api$chemin');

   // a GET request for which we want the body JSON; an exception if it is not a 2xx
  Future<dynamic> _lire(String chemin) async {
    final reponse = await widget.client.get(_url(chemin));
    if (reponse.statusCode >= 300) throw ReponseEnErreur(reponse);
    return jsonDecode(utf8.decode(reponse.bodyBytes));
  }

   // a POST with a body of JSON
  Future<http.Response> _poster(String chemin, Object corps) {
    return widget.client.post(
      _url(chemin),
      headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, // the body is JSON
      body: jsonEncode(corps),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _chargerCaptcha() async {
    final captcha = await _lire('/captcha') as Map<String, dynamic>;
    _reponseCaptcha.clear();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _captcha = captcha);
  }

  Future<void> _chargerMedecins() async {
    final medecins = await _lire('/medecins') as List<dynamic>;
    if (mounted) setState(() => _medecins = medecins);
  }

   // 1. Who is logged in? 200 -> the user; 401 -> no one
  Future<void> _verifierSession() async {
    try {
      final utilisateur = await _lire('/auth/moi') as Map<String, dynamic>;
      setState(() => _utilisateur = utilisateur);
      await _chargerMedecins();
    } on ReponseEnErreur catch (e) {
       // "on Type catch": does not catch this type of exception (QUE)
      if (e.reponse.statusCode == 401) {
        await _chargerCaptcha();
      } else {
        _erreurServeur = 'Le serveur a répondu ${e.reponse.statusCode}.';
      }
    } catch (_) {
      _erreurServeur = 'Le serveur JSON RdvMedecins est-il lancé (${Config.urlServeur}) ?';
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => _pret = true);
  }

   // 2. The connection: an action performed by the command, which logs its error
  Future<void> _seConnecter() async {
    final reponse = await _poster('/auth/login', {
      'login': _login.text.trim(),
      'password': _password.text,
      'captchaId': _captcha?['id'],
      'captcha': _reponseCaptcha.text,
    });
    if (reponse.statusCode != 200) {
       // the body JSON of the error response: { statusCode, key, ... }
      final erreur = jsonDecode(reponse.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final cle = erreur['cle'] as String;
      await _chargerCaptcha(); // Each image is used only once
      throw '${reponse.statusCode} - ${messages[cle] ?? cle}'; // You can start... a thread
    }
    _password.clear();
    setState(() => _utilisateur = jsonDecode(reponse.body) as Map<String, dynamic>);
    await _chargerMedecins();
  }

   // 4. Logout
  Future<void> _seDeconnecter() async {
    await _poster('/auth/logout', {});
    setState(() {
      _utilisateur = null;
      _medecins = [];
    });
    await _chargerCaptcha();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Widget contenu;
    final utilisateur = _utilisateur;
    if (!_pret) {
      contenu = const Text('Vérification de la session...', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey));
    } else if (utilisateur != null) {
       // logged in
      contenu = Card(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text.rich(
                TextSpan(
                  children: [
                    const TextSpan(text: 'Connecté : '),
                    TextSpan(
                      text: '${utilisateur['nom']}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                    ),
                    TextSpan(text: ' (${utilisateur['login']}), rôle ${utilisateur['role']}'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text('GET /api/medecins', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall),
              for (final m in _medecins) Text('• ${m['titre']} ${m['prenom']} ${m['nom']}'),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                "Arrêtez puis relancez l'application : vous restez connecté.",
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              OutlinedButton(onPressed: _seDeconnecter, child: const Text('Se déconnecter')),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else if (_erreurServeur == null) {
       // not logged in: the form
      contenu = Card(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: _login,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Login'),
              ),
              TextField(
                controller: _password,
                obscureText: true,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Mot de passe'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(
                children: [
                  if (_captcha != null) SvgPicture.string('${_captcha!['svg']}', height: 50),
                  TextButton(onPressed: _chargerCaptcha, child: const Text('Autre image')),
                ],
              ),
              TextField(
                controller: _reponseCaptcha,
                autocorrect: false,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: "Recopiez les caractères de l'image"),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
               // ListenableBuilder: this section tracks the order status
              ListenableBuilder(
                listenable: _connexion,
                builder: (context, _) => Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: _connexion.enCours ? null : () => _connexion.executer(_seConnecter),
                      child: Text(_connexion.enCours ? 'Connexion...' : 'Se connecter'),
                    ),
                    if (_connexion.erreur != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                        child: Text('${_connexion.erreur}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              const Text(
                'Comptes : admin, pelissier, martin... (mot de passe = login).',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    } else {
      contenu = const SizedBox.shrink(); // an "empty" widget
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Exemple 23 - connexion au serveur')),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          contenu,
          if (_erreurServeur != null)
            Card(
              color: Colors.red.shade50,
              child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), child: Text(_erreurServeur!)),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
  • lines 36–41: The client HTTP, which stores its cookies on the device, is created at startup and passed to the screen;
  • lines 47–49: an exception that captures the response as an error (its status code can be read there). [implements Exception]: an object that can be invoked ([throw]);
  • lines 90–93: a request (GET) from which we want the body (JSON), and an exception if the status code is not a 2xx. [widget.client.get(...)]: the client with cookies. [utf8.decode(reponse.bodyBytes)]: the body decoded to UTF-8 (the accents), regardless of what the response header says;
  • lines 97–101: a POST: the header is [content-type: application/json] and the body is in JSON (the server rejects a POST that is not in JSON);
  • Lines 117–132: 1. At startup: Who is connected? [GET /api/auth/moi]: 200, the user; 401, no one. [on ReponseEnErreur catch (e)] does not catch this type of exception for QUE; the next one, [catch], and all others (no response at all);
  • lines 136–152: 2. connection: [POST /api/auth/login]. If the request is rejected, the body of the error response provides the message key; a new image is loaded (each one is used only once), then the message is sent: in [Dart], any object can be sent—in this case, a string. It is the command that captures and stores it;
  • lines 156–162: 4. Logout: [POST /api/auth/logout]; the server deletes the cookie (and the client deletes its cookies as well);
  • lines 193–197: 3. logged in: the list of doctors ([GET /api/medecins], a protected request: the cookie accompanies it);
  • lines 225–226: the CAPTCHA and its button;
  • lines 236–248: the button reflects the status of the request: disabled and “Logging in...” while the request is being sent; any error message appears below.

The login screen; an incorrect password; successful login:

Close and then restart the application: it will start up logged in. The cookie, stored on the device, is presented to [GET /api/auth/moi], and the server responds with the user’s credentials. The token expires after two hours: [GET /api/auth/moi] will then return a 401 response, and the login screen will reappear.

docs.title: 9.3. Example 24: An Access Layer for API
docs.text: In Example 23, each request repeated the same steps. This example organizes them into three layers, which the case study will revisit.

docs.title: 9.3.1. The types
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/types.dart - the JSON objects exchanged with the API RdvMedecins
// (see the chapter on the black box, which describes each route)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The decoded JSON is untyped: Map<String, dynamic>, List...
// Each class has a "factory" constructor depuisJson that VÉRIFIE takes the form
// of the received JSON, through Dart 3 "filtering" (pattern matching):
//
//    switch (json) {
//      {'login': String login, 'name': String name} =  > ... // the expected format
//      _ => throw FormatException(.                    ..) // everything else
//   }
//
// The pattern {'login': String login, ...} verifies that json is a Map, that
// these keys exist, that their values are of the correct type, and stores these
// values into variables. An unexpected response is detected
// immediately, rather than later, in the middle of the display.
// =========================================================================

enum Role { admin, doctor, user }

// "ADMIN" -> Role.admin
Role _role(String nom) => Role.values.byName(nom.toLowerCase());

// POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me
class Utilisateur {
  final String login;
  final String nom;
  final Role role;

  const Utilisateur(this.login, this.nom, this.role);

  factory Utilisateur.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {'login': final String login, 'nom': final String nom, 'role': final String role} => Utilisateur(
      login,
      nom,
      _role(role),
    ),
    _ => throw FormatException('Utilisateur inattendu : $json'),
  };
}

// GET /api/captcha
class Captcha {
  final String id;
  final String svg;

  const Captcha(this.id, this.svg);

  factory Captcha.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {'id': final String id, 'svg': final String svg} => Captcha(id, svg),
    _ => throw FormatException('Captcha inattendu : $json'),
  };
}

// a doctor or a client (GET /api/doctors, GET /api/clients...)
class Personne {
  final int id;
  final int version;
  final String titre;
  final String prenom;
  final String nom;
  final String? login; // only for ADMIN

  const Personne(this.id, this.version, this.titre, this.prenom, this.nom, [this.login]);

  factory Personne.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {
      'id': final int id,
      'version': final int version,
      'titre': final String titre,
      'prenom': final String prenom,
      'nom': final String nom,
    } =>
       // The "login" key is optional: it is read separately
      Personne(id, version, titre, prenom, nom, (json as Map<String, Object?>)['login'] as String?),
    _ => throw FormatException('Personne inattendue : $json'),
  };

   // a list JSON -> a list of people
  static List<Personne> liste(Object? json) => [for (final p in json as List<Object?>) Personne.depuisJson(p)];

  String get nomComplet => '$titre $prenom $nom';
}

// a person’s name, with nothing else
class Identite {
  final String titre;
  final String prenom;
  final String nom;

  const Identite(this.titre, this.prenom, this.nom);

  factory Identite.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {'titre': final String titre, 'prenom': final String prenom, 'nom': final String nom} => Identite(
      titre,
      prenom,
      nom,
    ),
    _ => throw FormatException('Identité inattendue : $json'),
  };

  @override
  String toString() => '$titre $prenom $nom';
}

// a line from GET /api/agenda
class CreneauAgenda {
  final int id;
  final int hdebut;
  final int mdebut;
  final int hfin;
  final int mfin;
  final bool libre;
  final Identite? patient;
  final bool moi;
  final bool reservable;
  final int? idRv;

  const CreneauAgenda(
    this.id,
    this.hdebut,
    this.mdebut,
    this.hfin,
    this.mfin,
    this.libre,
    this.patient,
    this.moi,
    this.reservable,
    this.idRv,
  );

  factory CreneauAgenda.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {
      'id': final int id,
      'hdebut': final int hdebut,
      'mdebut': final int mdebut,
      'hfin': final int hfin,
      'mfin': final int mfin,
      'libre': final bool libre,
      'patient': final Object? patient,
      'moi': final bool moi,
      'reservable': final bool reservable,
      'idRv': final int? idRv,
    } =>
      CreneauAgenda(
        id,
        hdebut,
        mdebut,
        hfin,
        mfin,
        libre,
        patient == null ? null : Identite.depuisJson(patient),
        moi,
        reservable,
        idRv,
      ),
    _ => throw FormatException('Créneau inattendu : $json'),
  };

  // "8:00 - 8:20"
  String get horaire {
    String hm(int h, int m) => '$h:${m.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    return '${hm(hdebut, mdebut)} - ${hm(hfin, mfin)}';
  }
}

// GET /api/agenda?idMedecin=...&day=...
class Agenda {
  final Personne medecin;
  final String jour;
  final List<CreneauAgenda> creneaux;
  final String? info;

  const Agenda(this.medecin, this.jour, this.creneaux, this.info);

  factory Agenda.depuisJson(Object? json) => switch (json) {
    {
      'medecin': final Object medecin,
      'jour': final String jour,
      'creneaux': final List<Object?> creneaux,
      'info': final String? info,
    } =>
      Agenda(Personne.depuisJson(medecin), jour, [for (final c in creneaux) CreneauAgenda.depuisJson(c)], info),
    _ => throw FormatException('Agenda inattendu : $json'),
  };
}

The decoded JSON is untyped: [Map], [List], [dynamic]. Each class has a factory constructor [depuisJson] that validates the format of the received JSON. A [factory] constructor does not necessarily create a new object: it is a function that returns an object of the class.

  • Lines 33–39: [Dart] 3 pattern matching applied to JSON. The pattern [{'login': final String login, 'nom': final String nom, 'role': final String role}] verifies that [json] is a [Map], that these three keys exist, that their values are strings, and stores these values in three variables. If JSON has a different format, as is the case with [_], it is treated as an exception. An unexpected response is thus detected as soon as it is received, rather than later, in the middle of the display;
  • line 23: “ADMIN” -> [Role.admin]: [byName] retrieves an enumeration value by its name;
  • lines 67–76: the pattern checks for required keys; the optional key [login] is read separately;
  • line 81: a list JSON -> a list of people;
  • lines 133–144: [final Object? patient] accepts any value, including [null]; [final int? idRv], an integer, or [null];
  • lines 162–164: a formatting getter.

docs.title: 9.3.2. Errors
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/erreur_api.dart - UNE class for all errors from API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All error responses from the RdvMedecins server have the same format:
//    { "statusCode": 409, "cle": "ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN", "params": {...}, "fields": {...} }
// But a request can also fail (AUTREMENT): no response at all
// (network down, server down, incorrect address), or a response that
// come from our server (an error page from a proxy). We convert
// all of this in the UNE class, ErreurApi, which contains the translation key
// sent by the server (and, if any, its parameters and the error for
// for each field).
// =========================================================================

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

// "implements Exception": an object that can be thrown and caught
class ErreurApi implements Exception {
  final int statusCode; // 0: the server did not respond
  final String cle; // e.g., 'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN'
  final Map<String, String> params;
  final Map<String, String> champs;

  const ErreurApi(this.statusCode, this.cle, {this.params = const {}, this.champs = const {}});

   // an error response (4xx, 5xx) -> a ErreurApi
  factory ErreurApi.depuisReponse(http.Response reponse) {
    Object? corps;
    try {
      corps = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(reponse.bodyBytes));
    } on FormatException {
      corps = null; // not JSON: this response did not come from our server
    }
     // "filtering" (pattern matching) of a Map: if the body has a key
     // "key" of type String, it is stored in the variable key
    if (corps case {'cle': final String cle}) {
      final json = corps as Map<String, Object?>;
      return ErreurApi(reponse.statusCode, cle, params: _chaines(json['params']), champs: _chaines(json['champs']));
    }
     // No key: the proxy or the network responded instead
    return ErreurApi(
      reponse.statusCode,
      reponse.statusCode >= 500 ? 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE' : 'ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR',
    );
  }

   // an object JSON { "name": "ERRORS..." } -> Map<String, String> (empty otherwise)
  static Map<String, String> _chaines(Object? json) =>
      json is Map<String, Object?> ? {for (final e in json.entries) e.key: '${e.value}'} : const {};

  @override
  String toString() => '$statusCode $cle';
}

All error responses from the server have the same format. However, a request may also fail with AUTREMENT: no response at all, or a response that does not come from our server. We convert all of this into the UNE class, [ErreurApi].

  • Lines 19–23: a status (0: no response), a translation key, its parameters, and the error for each field;
  • lines 28–44: an error response → a [ErreurApi]. [if (corps case {'cle': final String cle})]: filtering in a [if] (“if-case”): if the body has a [cle] key of type string, it is stored in the [cle] variable. Otherwise, it was not our server that responded;
  • line 53: “401 LOGIN.ERROR,” for quick display.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/api.dart - requests to API, on a single line
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// In Example 23, each request repeated the same steps: the
// server address, the /api prefix, the JSON header, checking the status code, reading the
// error body... We’ve grouped them together here:
//
//    final json = await api.get('/doctors');
//    await api.post('/appointments', {'day': day, 'idCreneau': 3});
//
//    - if successful, the Future returns the body JSON, DÉCODÉ (Maps,
//      Lists, Strings, numbers, etc.);
//    - if the operation fails, it ends with a ErreurApi.
// All requests go through the `requete` method: this is where
// a problem like COMMUN would be handled for all of them (see the case study and the
// 401 response). Used in Examples 24 and 25.
// =========================================================================

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

import 'config.dart';
import 'erreur_api.dart';

class Api {
  final http.Client _client;

  Api(this._client);

  Future<Object?> requete(String methode, String url, [Object? corps]) async {
    final requete = http.Request(methode, Uri.parse('${Config.urlServeur}/api$url'));
    if (corps != null) {
       // a body JSON (the server rejects a POST that is not a body)
      requete.headers['content-type'] = 'application/json';
      requete.body = jsonEncode(corps);
    }
    final http.Response reponse;
    try {
       // send sends the request; fromStream waits for the complete response body
      reponse = await http.Response.fromStream(await _client.send(requete));
    } catch (_) {
       // AUCUNE response (network issue, server down, incorrect address)
      throw const ErreurApi(0, 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE');
    }
    if (reponse.statusCode >= 400) {
      throw ErreurApi.depuisReponse(reponse);
    }
    return reponse.bodyBytes.isEmpty ? null : jsonDecode(utf8.decode(reponse.bodyBytes));
  }

  Future<Object?> get(String url) => requete('GET', url);
   // a POST always has a body JSON: {} by default
  Future<Object?> post(String url, [Object corps = const {}]) => requete('POST', url, corps);
  Future<Object?> put(String url, Object corps) => requete('PUT', url, corps);
  Future<Object?> delete(String url, [Object? corps]) => requete('DELETE', url, corps);
}
  • Lines 31–49: TOUTES—requests go through this method: the server address and the prefix [/api], the body in JSON, the transmission ([_client.send], followed by [http.Response.fromStream], which waits for the complete body), errors converted to [ErreurApi], and the decoded response body. This is where we would handle a problem common to all requests (see the case study and the 401 response);
  • lines 52–56: four shortcuts. A POST always has a body of JSON: [{}] by default.

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/commun/barre_connexion.dart - log in/log out, in a single bar
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The form from Example 23, reduced to a single bar and rewritten using api.dart.
// The widget calls onUtilisateurChange with the logged-in user (or
// null) whenever the user changes—including at startup, after
// querying GET /api/auth/moi. The Api object is read from the context
// (provided by the provider; see the main function in Examples 24 and 25).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'erreur_api.dart';
import 'types.dart';

class BarreConnexion extends StatefulWidget {
  final ValueChanged<Utilisateur?> onUtilisateurChange;

  const BarreConnexion({super.key, required this.onUtilisateurChange});

  @override
  State<BarreConnexion> createState() => _BarreConnexionState();
}

class _BarreConnexionState extends State<BarreConnexion> {
   // late: read from the context, in initState
  late final Api _api = context.read<Api>();
  Utilisateur? _utilisateur;
  Captcha? _captcha;
  final _login = TextEditingController(text: 'admin');
  final _password = TextEditingController();
  final _reponseCaptcha = TextEditingController();
  String? _erreur;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _demarrer();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _login.dispose();
    _password.dispose();
    _reponseCaptcha.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _changer(Utilisateur? u) {
    setState(() => _utilisateur = u);
    widget.onUtilisateurChange(u);
  }

  Future<void> _nouveauCaptcha() async {
    final captcha = Captcha.depuisJson(await _api.get('/captcha'));
    _reponseCaptcha.clear();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _captcha = captcha);
  }

   // on startup: are we already logged in?
  Future<void> _demarrer() async {
    try {
      _changer(Utilisateur.depuisJson(await _api.get('/auth/moi')));
    } on ErreurApi {
      _changer(null); // 401: No one is logged in
      try {
        await _nouveauCaptcha();
      } on ErreurApi {
        setState(() => _erreur = 'Le serveur JSON est-il lancé (port 8080) ?');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _seConnecter() async {
    setState(() => _erreur = null);
    try {
      final u = Utilisateur.depuisJson(
        await _api.post('/auth/login', {
          'login': _login.text.trim(),
          'password': _password.text,
          'captchaId': _captcha?.id,
          'captcha': _reponseCaptcha.text,
        }),
      );
      _password.clear();
      _changer(u);
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      setState(() => _erreur = '$e'); // "401 LOGIN.ERROR"
      await _nouveauCaptcha();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _seDeconnecter() async {
    await _api.post('/auth/logout');
    _changer(null);
    await _nouveauCaptcha();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final u = _utilisateur;
    return Card(
      color: Colors.blueGrey.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
        child: u != null
            ? Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.person),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(child: Text('${u.nom} (${u.role.name.toUpperCase()})')),
                  TextButton(onPressed: _seDeconnecter, child: const Text('Se déconnecter')),
                ],
              )
            : Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: TextField(
                          controller: _login,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'login', isDense: true),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: TextField(
                          controller: _password,
                          obscureText: true,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'mot de passe', isDense: true),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                       // the SVG CAPTCHA image, generated by the NOTRE server (see example 22)
                      if (_captcha != null) SvgPicture.string(_captcha!.svg, height: 40),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: TextField(
                          controller: _reponseCaptcha,
                          autocorrect: false,
                          decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'captcha', isDense: true),
                        ),
                      ),
                      IconButton(tooltip: 'Se connecter', icon: const Icon(Icons.login), onPressed: _seConnecter),
                    ],
                  ),
                  if (_erreur != null) Text(_erreur!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                ],
              ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

The form from Example 23, reduced to a single bar and rewritten using [Api]. It calls [onUtilisateurChange] whenever the logged-in user changes, including at startup.

  • Line 30: The object [Api] is provided earlier (by [provider]); [late]: It is read only upon its first use, in [initState];
  • Lines 64–72: At startup, who is connected? [Utilisateur.depuisJson(await _api.get('/auth/moi'))]: one line. Any [ErreurApi] means “no one”;
  • lines 77–92: the connection, in a few lines: errors appear as [ErreurApi].

docs.title: 9.3.5. The API access layer
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex24_couche_api/rdvmedecins.dart - the access layer to API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A route-based method of the API, typed. The screens do not recognize either the
// URL, the HTTP packet, or the JSON format: they call methods
// that return Dart objects (Person, Calendar, etc.).
// This is the client-side equivalent of the server-side DAO layer: if the API
// changes (a URL, a field name), only this file is modified.
// In the Flutter architecture guide, this is a “repository.”
// =========================================================================

import '../commun/api.dart';
import '../commun/types.dart';

class RdvMedecins {
  final Api _api;

  RdvMedecins(this._api);

  Future<List<Personne>> getMedecins() async => Personne.liste(await _api.get('/medecins'));

  Future<List<Personne>> getClients() async => Personne.liste(await _api.get('/clients'));

   // Uri generates "idMedecin=1&jour=2030-01-15" by encoding the necessary information
  Future<Agenda> getAgenda(int idMedecin, String jour) async {
    final parametres = Uri(queryParameters: {'idMedecin': '$idMedecin', 'jour': jour}).query;
    return Agenda.depuisJson(await _api.get('/agenda?$parametres'));
  }

   // [int? idClient]: an optional parameter. '?idClient' in the Map: the key
   // is only placed in the Map if idClient is not null (Dart 3.8)
  Future<void> reserver(String jour, int idCreneau, [int? idClient]) =>
      _api.post('/rendez-vous', {'jour': jour, 'idCreneau': idCreneau, 'idClient': ?idClient});

  Future<void> annuler(int idRv) => _api.delete('/rendez-vous/$idRv');
}

A method per route of the API, typed. The screens are unaware of the addresses, the [http] packet, or the JSON format: they call methods that return [Dart] objects. If the API changes (an address, a field name), only this file is modified. The [Flutter] architecture guide refers to this layer as a “repository.”

  • Line 26: [Uri] constructs the string “idMedecin=1&day=2030-01-15,” encoding the necessary data;
  • line 33: ['idClient': ?idClient] within a literal [Map]: the key is placed in the [Map] only if [idClient] is not [null] (the “optional elements” of [Dart] 3.8).

docs.title: 9.3.6. The view template
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex24_couche_api/agenda_modele.dart - the screen's "view model"
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The Flutter architecture guide recommends separating:
//    - VUE: widgets, which display and transmit the user’s actions
//      user;
//    - the MODÈLE DE VUE (ViewModel): a ChangeNotifier containing the
//      of the screen (the selected doctor, the date, the received appointment schedule...), the
//      actions (select, book, cancel), and which calls the layer
//      access layer for the API.
// The view no longer contains any business logic: it is easy to read; the view model
// has no widgets: it is easy to test.
//
// It also handles what we don’t want to have to rewrite for every screen:
//    - a CACHE: the schedule for each (doctor, day) that has already been viewed is saved;
//      it reappears immediately, while it’s being re-read in the background;
//    - responses PÉRIMÉES are ignored (see example 19).
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../commun/erreur_api.dart';
import '../commun/types.dart';
import 'rdvmedecins.dart';

String _deuxChiffres(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
String formatJour(DateTime d) => '${d.year}-${_deuxChiffres(d.month)}-${_deuxChiffres(d.day)}';

class AgendaModele extends ChangeNotifier {
  final RdvMedecins _rdvmedecins;

  AgendaModele(this._rdvmedecins);

   // ---- status ----
  Utilisateur? utilisateur;
  List<Personne> medecins = [];
  List<Personne> clients = [];
  int? idMedecin;
  String jour = formatJour(DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 1))); // tomorrow
  int? idClient;
  Agenda? agenda;
  bool chargement = false;
  ({bool succes, String texte})? message;

  final Map<String, Agenda> _cache = {};
  int _numeroLecture = 0;

   // ---- calculated values ----
  bool get connecte => utilisateur != null;
  bool get gestionnaire => connecte && utilisateur!.role != Role.user;

   // ---- actions ----
  Future<void> changerUtilisateur(Utilisateur? u) async {
    utilisateur = u;
    medecins = [];
    clients = [];
    agenda = null;
    idMedecin = null;
    _cache.clear(); // permissions have changed: forget everything
    notifyListeners();
    if (u == null) return;
    medecins = await _rdvmedecins.getMedecins();
    if (gestionnaire) clients = await _rdvmedecins.getClients(); // a USER would receive 403
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void choisirMedecin(int id) {
    idMedecin = id;
    message = null;
    _lireAgenda();
  }

  void choisirJour(DateTime d) {
    jour = formatJour(d);
    message = null;
    _lireAgenda();
  }

  void choisirClient(int? id) {
    idClient = id;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> reserver(CreneauAgenda c) =>
      _agir(() => _rdvmedecins.reserver(jour, c.id, gestionnaire ? idClient : null), 'Créneau ${c.horaire} réservé.');

  Future<void> annuler(CreneauAgenda c) =>
      _agir(() => _rdvmedecins.annuler(c.idRv!), 'Rendez-vous de ${c.horaire} annulé.');

   // an action, then TOUJOURS a review of the agenda: SERVEUR is the definitive version
  Future<void> _agir(Future<void> Function() action, String succes) async {
    try {
      await action();
      message = (succes: true, texte: succes);
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      message = (succes: false, texte: '$e');
    }
    await _lireAgenda();
  }

  Future<void> _lireAgenda() async {
    final id = idMedecin;
    if (id == null) return;
    final cle = '$id/$jour';
    final numero = ++_numeroLecture;
     // the cache first (or nothing), then the read
    agenda = _cache[cle];
    chargement = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final lu = await _rdvmedecins.getAgenda(id, jour);
      if (numero != _numeroLecture) return; // a more recent read was initiated
      agenda = _cache[cle] = lu;
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      if (numero != _numeroLecture) return;
      agenda = null;
      message = (succes: false, texte: '$e');
    }
    chargement = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

The [Flutter] architecture guide recommends separating the view (the widgets, which display and transmit user actions) and the view model (a [ChangeNotifier] that contains the screen’s state and its actions, and which calls the API access layer). The view no longer contains any logic; the view model has no widgets: it can be tested without a screen.

  • lines 35–43)? message;}: the screen state;
  • lines 45–46: a cache: the schedule for each (doctor, day) that has already been read is stored; returning to it displays it immediately while it is being reread. And the number of the last read entry, to ignore outdated responses (see Example 19). This, in a few lines, is what the [TanStack Query] library from the [React] course does;
  • lines 49–50: calculated values;
  • lines 53–64: a new user: we clear everything (permissions have changed), then read the doctors and, for ADMIN and DOCTOR, the clients (a USER would receive a 403);
  • lines 91–98: an action (book, cancel), then TOUJOURS a re-read of the calendar: the server’s response takes precedence;
  • lines 101–120: retrieving the calendar: first from the cache (or nothing), then the server’s response, unless a more recent retrieval was initiated in the meantime.

docs.title: 9.3.7. The screen
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex24_couche_api/main.dart - a calendar, with the access layer to API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Log in (top bar), select a doctor and a date:
// the calendar appears. ADMIN and DOCTOR can make an appointment for a patient, and
// cancel an appointment; a patient (Martin...) makes an appointment for themselves. Each action
// ends with a review of the calendar.
// Three layers, from bottom to top:
//    API (shared/api.dart         ) requests HTTP, errors;
//    RdvMedecins (rdvmedecins.dart) a route-typed method from API;
//    AgendaModele (agenda_modele.dart) the screen's state and actions;
// and the view below, which simply displays the model.
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../commun/api.dart';
import '../commun/barre_connexion.dart';
import '../commun/client_http.dart';
import '../commun/types.dart';
import 'agenda_modele.dart';
import 'rdvmedecins.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final api = Api(ClientAvecCookies(await SharedPreferences.getInstance()));
  runApp(
    MultiProvider(
      providers: [
         // Provider: returns a regular object (which does not trigger any notifications)
        Provider.value(value: api),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AgendaModele(RdvMedecins(api))),
      ],
      child: MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
        theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo),
        home: const PageAgenda(),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class PageAgenda extends StatelessWidget {
  const PageAgenda({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final modele = context.watch<AgendaModele>();
    final agenda = modele.agenda;
    final message = modele.message;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text("Exemple 24 - une couche d'accès à l'API")),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          BarreConnexion(onUtilisateurChange: modele.changerUtilisateur),
          if (modele.connecte) ...[
            DropdownButton<int>(
              isExpanded: true,
              hint: const Text('-- choisir un médecin --'),
              value: modele.idMedecin,
              items: [for (final m in modele.medecins) DropdownMenuItem(value: m.id, child: Text(m.nomComplet))],
              onChanged: (id) => modele.choisirMedecin(id!),
            ),
            Row(
              children: [
                Text('Jour : ${modele.jour}'),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_month),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final d = await showDatePicker(
                      context: context,
                      initialDate: DateTime.parse(modele.jour),
                      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                      lastDate: DateTime(2035),
                    );
                    if (d != null) modele.choisirJour(d);
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (modele.gestionnaire)
              DropdownButton<int?>(
                isExpanded: true,
                value: modele.idClient,
                items: [
                  const DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text('-- patient à inscrire --')),
                  for (final c in modele.clients) DropdownMenuItem(value: c.id, child: Text(c.nomComplet)),
                ],
                onChanged: modele.choisirClient,
              ),
            if (message != null)
              Card(
                color: message.succes ? Colors.green.shade50 : Colors.red.shade50,
                child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10), child: Text(message.texte)),
              ),
            if (modele.chargement) const LinearProgressIndicator(),
            if (agenda != null) ...[
               // info: the key sent by the server when a patient already has an upcoming appointment
              if (agenda.info != null) Text(agenda.info!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.blue)),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                child: Text(
                  'Agenda du ${agenda.jour} - ${agenda.medecin.nomComplet}',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall,
                ),
              ),
              for (final c in agenda.creneaux) _LigneCreneau(creneau: c),
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// A calendar entry: the time, the occupant, and the enabled buttons
class _LigneCreneau extends StatelessWidget {
  final CreneauAgenda creneau;

  const _LigneCreneau({required this.creneau});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = creneau;
    final modele = context.read<AgendaModele>();
    final Widget statut = c.libre
        ? Chip(label: const Text('Libre'), backgroundColor: Colors.green.shade100)
        : Chip(
            label: Text(c.patient?.toString() ?? 'Réservé'),
            backgroundColor: c.moi ? Colors.indigo.shade100 : Colors.grey.shade300,
          );
    return ListTile(
      dense: true,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      leading: SizedBox(width: 90, child: Text(c.horaire)),
      title: Align(alignment: Alignment.centerLeft, child: statut),
       // The buttons reflect the permissions calculated by the server
      trailing: c.reservable
          ? IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Réserver',
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline, color: Colors.green),
              onPressed: () => modele.reserver(c),
            )
          : c.idRv != null
          ? IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Annuler',
              icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel_outlined, color: Colors.red),
              onPressed: () => modele.annuler(c),
            )
          : null,
    );
  }
}
  • lines 28–34: the three layers, assembled at startup: [Api] (the requests), [RdvMedecins] (the routes), [AgendaModele] (the screen). [Provider.value] returns a regular object, which does not trigger any notifications;
  • line 50: the view subscribes to the view model;
  • line 58: the login bar notifies the model;
  • the rest is just display: each widget reads the model’s state and, when the user takes action, calls one of its methods ([modele.choisirMedecin(id!)], [modele.reserver(c)]...);
  • lines 120–153: a row in the calendar. The buttons follow the permissions calculated by the server ([reservable], [idRv]).

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// lib/ex25_erreurs_serveur/main.dart - display errors from SERVEUR
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Customer management (admin account). This form does not
// VOLONTAIREMENT perform any validation on the phone: everything is sent to the
// server, which responds, in case of rejection, with an error JSON (converted to
// ErreurApi by common/api.dart):
//
//    400 { key: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM', fields: { name: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED' } }
//    409 { key: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS', fields: { first_name: ..., last_name: ... } }
//    409 { key: 'ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE'         } (optimistic lock)
//
// The error for the CHAQUE field (ErreurApi.champs) is recorded in the status and
// displayed under the field (errorText); its message is the CLÉ sent by
// the server, which the screen translates (dictionaries from Example 21).
// Editing a field clears its error.
// Try this: an empty name, a title of “Dr.”, a namesake (Alice DURAND), a
// username already taken (martin), the same record edited on two devices...
// =========================================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../commun/api.dart';
import '../commun/barre_connexion.dart';
import '../commun/client_http.dart';
import '../commun/erreur_api.dart';
import '../commun/types.dart';
import '../ex16_confirmation/confirmation.dart';
import '../ex21_i18n/traductions.dart';
import '../ex23_connexion/commande.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final stockage = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  final traductions = Traductions('ex25', stockage);
  await traductions.demarrer();
  runApp(
    MultiProvider(
      providers: [
        Provider.value(value: Api(ClientAvecCookies(stockage))),
        ChangeNotifierProvider.value(value: traductions),
      ],
      child: MaterialApp(
        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
        theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.indigo),
        home: const PageClients(),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

// the form fields
enum Champ { titre, prenom, nom, login, password }

class PageClients extends StatefulWidget {
  const PageClients({super.key});

  @override
  State<PageClients> createState() => _PageClientsState();
}

class _PageClientsState extends State<PageClients> {
  late final Api _api = context.read<Api>();
  Utilisateur? _utilisateur;
  List<Personne> _clients = [];

   // the form: _idEdite == null -> create, otherwise update
  int? _idEdite;
  int _version = 0;
  String _titre = 'Mr';
  final _textes = {
    for (final c in [Champ.prenom, Champ.nom, Champ.login, Champ.password]) c: TextEditingController(),
  };
   // the error for each field (a translation: CLÉ), returned by the server
  Map<String, String> _erreurs = {};
   // the general message for the last error, and the success message (key + parameters)
  ErreurApi? _erreurPage;
  ({String cle, Map<String, String> params})? _succes;
   // the request sent to the server: a Command (e.g., 23), indicating whether it is in progress
  final _envoi = Commande();

  bool get _estAdmin => _utilisateur?.role == Role.admin;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final c in _textes.values) {
      c.dispose();
    }
    _envoi.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _recharger() async {
    final clients = Personne.liste(await _api.get('/clients'));
    if (mounted) setState(() => _clients = clients);
  }

  Future<void> _surConnexion(Utilisateur? u) async {
    setState(() {
      _utilisateur = u;
      _clients = [];
    });
    if (u?.role == Role.admin) await _recharger();
  }

  void _effacerMessages() {
    _erreurs = {};
    _erreurPage = null;
    _succes = null;
  }

  void _nouveau() {
    setState(() {
      _idEdite = null;
      _version = 0;
      _titre = 'Mr';
      for (final c in _textes.values) {
        c.clear();
      }
      _effacerMessages();
    });
  }

  void _editer(Personne c) {
    setState(() {
      _idEdite = c.id;
       // the VERSION read from the record is sent back with the modification: if someone
       // has modified the record in the meantime, the server will respond with a 409 error: CONCURRENT_UPDATE
      _version = c.version;
      _titre = c.titre;
      _textes[Champ.prenom]!.text = c.prenom;
      _textes[Champ.nom]!.text = c.nom;
      _textes[Champ.login]!.text = c.login ?? '';
      _textes[Champ.password]!.clear();
      _effacerMessages();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _enregistrer() async {
    setState(_effacerMessages);
    final saisie = {
      'titre': _titre,
      for (final MapEntry(key: champ, value: c) in _textes.entries) champ.name: c.text,
      'version': _version,
    };
    try {
      final client = Personne.depuisJson(
        _idEdite == null ? await _api.post('/clients', saisie) : await _api.put('/clients/$_idEdite', saisie),
      );
      final cle = _idEdite == null ? 'FORM.AJOUTE' : 'FORM.MODIFIE';
      _nouveau(); // form cleared, messages deleted...
       // ... except for this one
      setState(
        () => _succes = (cle: cle, params: {'nom': '${client.prenom} ${client.nom}', 'login': client.login ?? ''}),
      );
      await _recharger();
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _erreurPage = e; // the general message
        _erreurs = e.champs; // the error for each field
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _supprimer(Personne c) async {
    final t = context.read<Traductions>().t;
    final nom = '${c.prenom} ${c.nom}';
    final oui = await confirmer(context, t('FORM.CONFIRMER_SUPPRESSION', {'nom': nom}));
    if (!oui || !mounted) return;
    setState(_effacerMessages);
    try {
      await _api.delete('/clients/${c.id}');
      setState(() => _succes = (cle: 'FORM.SUPPRIME', params: {'nom': nom}));
    } on ErreurApi catch (e) {
      setState(() => _erreurPage = e);
    }
    await _recharger();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final traductions = context.watch<Traductions>();
    final t = traductions.t;

     // an input field, with its error (a server key) translated
    Widget champ(Champ c, {bool secret = false}) => TextField(
      controller: _textes[c],
      obscureText: secret,
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: t('FORM.${c.name.toUpperCase()}'),
        errorText: _erreurs[c.name] == null ? null : t(_erreurs[c.name]!),
        errorMaxLines: 2,
      ),
       // a modified field: its error disappears
      onChanged: (_) {
        if (_erreurs.containsKey(c.name)) setState(() => _erreurs = {..._erreurs}..remove(c.name));
      },
    );

    final succes = _succes;
    final erreurPage = _erreurPage;
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(t('FORM.TITRE_PAGE')),
        actions: [
           // Language: a menu
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.translate),
            onSelected: traductions.changerLangue,
            itemBuilder: (_) => [for (final l in langues) PopupMenuItem(value: l, child: Text(l.toUpperCase()))],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          BarreConnexion(onUtilisateurChange: _surConnexion),
          if (_utilisateur != null && !_estAdmin)
            Card(
              color: Colors.amber.shade50,
              child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12), child: Text(t('FORM.ADMIN_SEULEMENT'))),
            ),
          if (_estAdmin) ...[
            for (final c in _clients)
              ListTile(
                dense: true,
                title: Text(c.nomComplet),
                subtitle: Text(c.login ?? ''),
                trailing: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    IconButton(tooltip: t('FORM.MODIFIER'), icon: const Icon(Icons.edit), onPressed: () => _editer(c)),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: t('FORM.SUPPRIMER'),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: Colors.red),
                      onPressed: () => _supprimer(c),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      t(_idEdite == null ? 'FORM.TITRE_AJOUT' : 'FORM.TITRE_MODIF'),
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                    ),
                     // a "Dr" title that the server will reject: to see ERRORS.INVALID_TITLE
                    DropdownButton<String>(
                      value: _titre,
                      items: [
                        for (final titre in ['Mr', 'Mme', 'Melle', 'Dr'])
                          DropdownMenuItem(value: titre, child: Text(titre)),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (v) => setState(() {
                        _titre = v!;
                        _erreurs = {..._erreurs}..remove('titre');
                      }),
                    ),
                    if (_erreurs['titre'] != null)
                      Text(t(_erreurs['titre']!), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 12)),
                    champ(Champ.prenom),
                    champ(Champ.nom),
                    champ(Champ.login),
                    champ(Champ.password, secret: true),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    ListenableBuilder(
                      listenable: _envoi,
                      builder: (context, _) => Wrap(
                        spacing: 8,
                        children: [
                          FilledButton(
                            onPressed: _envoi.enCours ? null : () => _envoi.executer(_enregistrer),
                            child: Text(t('FORM.ENREGISTRER')),
                          ),
                          OutlinedButton(onPressed: _nouveau, child: Text(t('FORM.ANNULER'))),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (succes != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                        child: Text(t(succes.cle, succes.params), style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.green)),
                      ),
                     // the general message and the status HTTP, to understand
                    if (erreurPage != null)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                        child: Text.rich(
                          TextSpan(
                            children: [
                              TextSpan(
                                text: t(erreurPage.cle, erreurPage.params),
                                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                              ),
                              TextSpan(
                                text: '  ($erreurPage)',
                                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

Customer management (admin account). This form does not perform any validation on the phone: everything is sent to the server, which responds—in case of rejection—with an error JSON, converted to [ErreurApi].

  • Lines 37–43: the translations from Example 21, using the dictionaries from that example;
  • line 77: the error for each field: a CLÉ translation error, returned by the server;
  • lines 79–82: the general message for the last error, the success message, and the [Commande] sent to the server (Example 23);
  • lines 126–131: the version read from the record is updated with the change: if someone has modified the record in the meantime, the server will respond with a 409 [CONCURRENT_UPDATE] (optimistic lock);
  • lines 141–162: the save operation: [POST /api/clients] (creation) or [PUT /api/clients/:id] (update). If the operation is rejected, [ErreurApi] returns a general error message and the specific error for each field;
  • lines 188–198: an input field: its error, a server key, is translated and displayed below the field ([errorText]); editing the field clears its error;
  • lines 209–212: a menu in the top bar for language selection;
  • line 257: a “Dr” title, which the server will reject: see [ERRORS.INVALID_TITLE];
  • lines 291–302: the general message, translated, and, for context, the status HTTP and the key.

An empty form; a homonym (“Alice DURAND”); the same, in English:
